item.title: Amazon investirá US$1 bi em cinco anos em comunidades de data centers dos EUA
item.description: A divisão de computação em nuvem da Amazon afirmou nesta sexta-feira que investirá mais de US$1 bilhão nos próximos cinco anos em comunidades dos Estados Unidos onde possui data centers e prometeu abordar os impactos desses centros no consumo de eletricidade e água.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A divisão de computação em nuvem da Amazon (AMZN.O) afirmou nesta sexta-feira que investirá mais de US$1 bilhão nos próximos cinco anos em comunidades dos Estados Unidos onde possui data centers e prometeu abordar os impactos desses centros no consumo de eletricidade e água. Os data centers, que fornecem o poder computacional para treinar e executar modelos de inteligência artificial, têm gerado oposição em comunidades de todo o país devido a preocupações com a demanda de eletricidade, custos de serviços públicos e outros impactos locais. Essa reação negativa representa um desafio político para os republicanos às vésperas das eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA, em 3 de novembro. A Amazon afirmou ter investido US$276 bilhões em data centers entre 2011 e 2025 e que tinha grandes projetos ou expansões em andamento em muitos estados, incluindo Indiana, Louisiana, Carolina do Norte, Virgínia e Mississippi. A Amazon Web Services afirmou que os planos de investimento comunitário anunciados nesta sexta-feira incluirão gastos com educação, treinamento profissional, acessibilidade à energia, preservação de água e energia e outras prioridades locais em partes dos EUA onde possui centros de dados. Em um longo comunicado, a empresa procurou refutar as críticas aos centros de dados relacionadas aos impactos ambientais, energéticos e econômicos, e observou que mais de 100 moratórias para data centers estavam sendo consideradas em todo o país. "Há urgência na expansão desses data centers porque não somos o único país que reconhece os benefícios da IA para a economia e a segurança nacional, e os países que lideram em IA irão moldá-la e tirar o máximo proveito dela", disse Matt Garman, presidente-executivo da AWS. A AWS também se comprometeu a ser positiva em relação à água em todos os seus data centers até 2030, devolvendo mais água às comunidades do que utiliza, e afirmou estar 75% perto de atingir essa meta. (Por David Shepardson)

item.title: Países do G7 concordam em liberar reservas de diesel e petróleo após pressão dos EUA
item.description: Os países do Grupo dos Sete chegaram a um acordo nesta sexta-feira sobre a liberação de 100 milhões de barris de diesel e petróleo das reservas de emergência, em uma medida elogiada pelo presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, que busca ajuda para conter a alta dos preços dos combustíveis associada ao conflito com o Irã.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os países do Grupo dos Sete chegaram a um acordo nesta sexta-feira sobre a liberação de 100 milhões de barris de diesel e petróleo das reservas de emergência, em uma medida elogiada pelo presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, que busca ajuda para conter a alta dos preços dos combustíveis associada ao conflito com o Irã. O conflito provocou, em março, a maior liberação de estoques de emergência da história, coordenada pela Agência Internacional de Energia (IEA, na sigla em inglês). "Levando em conta os compromissos já cumpridos, implementaremos nossos compromissos com uma liberação coordenada, por meio da IEA, de 100 milhões de barris", afirmou o G7 em comunicado conjunto. O grupo informou que a medida terá início imediato e durará quatro meses, com uma liberação substancial de diesel concentrada no início, a ser realizada pelos membros e parceiros do G7 em até 20 dias. Não foram fornecidos detalhes sobre os volumes de petróleo, diesel e outros produtos a serem liberados, nem informados quais países participariam. "Nos reuniremos no âmbito da IEA nos próximos dias para discutir a possibilidade de liberações adicionais de diesel, conforme necessário", acrescentou o comunicado. "A Europa acaba de concordar em liberar uma quantidade enorme de seu diesel, que está em estoque em grande volume. O processo terá início imediatamente", escreveu Trump em uma postagem no Truth Social na sexta-feira. O presidente dos EUA busca reduzir os preços internos dos combustíveis antes das eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro. O governo Trump havia dito à Alemanha e à França para reduzirem seus estoques de emergência de diesel ou enfrentarem uma possível proibição de exportação de diesel pelos EUA, informou a Reuters na quinta-feira, citando três pessoas próximas às discussões. O comunicado do G7 afirmou que os países membros se absteriam de impor restrições à exportação de produtos energéticos entre si. "Trata-se de uma declaração política, e não de um compromisso específico e vinculativo, com um número expressivo nas manchetes destinado a persuadir o presidente Trump a não impor uma proibição à exportação de diesel", afirmaram analistas da Energy Aspects em uma nota. A Europa aumentou suas importações de diesel dos EUA este ano devido à interrupção no abastecimento dos produtores do Golfo, causada pela guerra no Irã. Os governos da UE discutiram na sexta-feira uma proposta da França para que os países europeus liberassem 50 milhões de barris de diesel e para que os membros da IEA liberassem 50 milhões de barris de petróleo, segundo informaram à Reuters três fontes a par das discussões. A liberação de 50 milhões de barris de diesel equivaleria a aproximadamente 17% do total das reservas de emergência de diesel e gasóleo da UE, segundo dados do Eurostat, ou cerca de 3% do consumo anual do bloco. Os futuros de diesel dos EUA caíram após notícias sobre as discussões sobre a liberação de estoques, registrando queda de mais de 4%, para US$4,4491 por galão. Os futuros de referência do diesel europeu caíram mais de US$90 por tonelada métrica, segundo dados da LSEG. A liberação em março, coordenada pela IEA, que conta com 32 membros, envolveu 400 milhões de barris de reservas estratégicas. O diretor-executivo da IEA, Fatih Birol, afirmou nesta semana que os membros haviam liberado cerca de dois terços desses volumes.

item.title: US judge blocks Trump administration from publishing names of universities' foreign donors
item.description: A federal judge has blocked the US Department of Education from publicly disclosing the names of foreign donors who provided thousands of gifts to universities throughout the country, saying the institutions had supplied the information on the understanding it would be kept confidential.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A federal judge has blocked the US Department of Education from publicly disclosing the names of foreign donors who provided thousands of gifts to universities throughout the country, saying the institutions had supplied the information on the understanding it would be kept confidential. US District Judge Tanya Chutkan in Washington issued a temporary restraining order close to midnight on Thursday that bars the department from publishing the names. The donor names had been set to be released on Friday as part of a broader effort by President Donald Trump's administration to [USN:L6N3ZJ0ZL TEXT:"scrutinize foreign funding of universities."] The judge issued the order at the behest of the Association of American Universities, which represents 69 research universities nationally, including Ivy League schools like Columbia, the University of Pennsylvania and Yale. Chutkan, who was appointed by Democratic President Barack Obama, said AAU was likely to succeed in proving that the Education Department's decision to publish information it had previously promised to keep secret was arbitrary and capricious and violated the Administrative Procedure Act. "Defendants threaten to imminently publish the names of donors who have hitherto remained anonymous for every internet user to see in posterity," she wrote. "Once published, the information will likely never escape the public eye." Her order barred the Education Department from making the donor information public and will remain in place for 28 days while she considers whether to issue a longer-term injunction. AAU in a statement welcomed the ruling, saying disclosure of the donor information "would chill the lawful generosity that supports scholarships, research, and teaching on campuses across the country." Education Department spokesperson Ellen Keast in a statement called the lawsuit an attempt to avoid public accountability for how universities for years have been "cashing multi-million-dollar checks from malign foreign actors." "Americans deserve transparency about the billions flowing from overseas to US campuses, and we will fight AAU in court to deliver it," Keast said. AAU sued earlier on Thursday after the Education Department announced plans to publish the names of individual foreign donors that it had collected from the universities since 2020, during Trump's first administration. Trump in April 2025 issued an executive order calling for enforcement of Section 117 of the Higher Education Act, which requires colleges that receive federal funding to report gifts or contracts worth more than $250,000 from any foreign source. AAU said the statute only calls for universities to report aggregate donations attributable to a particular country, not the identities of specific donors. But in 2020, the Education Department began requesting individual donor and contractor names and addresses as well. AAU said its members complied, even though they were not legally required to do so, because the department promised that such information would not be made public. The Education Department announced in July it would name the donors and published the identities of a limited set of 92 donors it called "counterparties of concern" later that month. It agreed on several occasions to delay releasing the other names, leading to Friday's planned publication date. The case is Association of American Universities v. US Department of Education, US District Court for the District of Columbia, No. 1:26-cv-03438. For AAU: Lindsay Harrison of Jenner & Block For the government: Esam Al-Shareffi of the US Department of Justice

item.title: Judge warns AI could stunt lawyers' training and harm their clients
item.description: A federal judge has warned that law firms' increasing use of artificial intelligence could create risks for clients and hinder the training of junior lawyers, even as he declined to sanction attorneys over AI-generated errors in a court filing.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: A federal judge has warned that law firms' increasing use of artificial intelligence could create risks for clients and hinder the training of junior lawyers, even as he declined to sanction attorneys over AI-generated errors in a court filing. Manhattan-based US District Judge Arun Subramanian said in an order this week that the episode should serve as a "wakeup call" for lawyers, cautioning that AI-generated legal work must be carefully checked for accuracy. "While clients may demand the use of AI to save money, there is a risk of adverse consequences when things go wrong," Subramanian wrote. "For this reason, it might make sense to clients to think hard before requiring counsel to use AI for tasks such as the drafting of briefs." State and federal judges [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"increasingly are weighing"] whether and how to sanction lawyers over their misuse of AI as the technology becomes more widespread. In the New York case, Subramanian in an order last month questioned whether "unchecked" use of AI led to citation errors in a copyright infringement case he was overseeing. The judge this week declined to impose sanctions on the lawyers after Cynthia Arato, an attorney for defendant Foundation Media, apologized and said the errors stemmed from another lawyer at her firm who was responsible for preparing the initial draft and finalizing it before it was filed. Arato said in a declaration this week that the lawyer, who was not named in Arato's declaration, acted "contrary to the firm's policies and training" and that the failure to check AI-generated citations was "an isolated error and not any bad faith or intent to mislead or deceive the court." She said her firm, Shapiro Arato Bach, was implementing further safeguards against AI misuse. In a filing submitted on Thursday, Arato disclosed that the firm had used AI tools created by technology company Harvey to help prepare the improperly vetted filing. Harvey and Foundation Media did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Subramanian said in his order that the legal profession should "think about ways to ensure that junior lawyers are getting the training they need, even as reliance on these technological tools increases." He suggested that firms could require initial drafts of briefs to be prepared without AI assistance. "The use of AI may be unavoidable, but mentoring young lawyers is a joint responsibility that we all share," Subramanian wrote. Read more: [USN:L6N45L181 TEXT:"Florida lawyer denies submitting ‘AI slop’ in bid to dodge court sanctions"] [USN:L6N42308A TEXT:"AI error-ridden court filings surge despite three years of sanctions"] [USN:L6N4521AB TEXT:"Lawyer cites fake witnesses in murder case and blames ChatGPT"] [USN:L6N456132 TEXT:"Lawyer for State Farm fined over AI hallucination in Los Angeles lawsuit"] [USN:L6N451168 TEXT:"Oklahoma judge used AI in ruling that contained false citations, prosecutor says"] [USN:L6N44S0X9 TEXT:"Mississippi asks appeals court to reassign judge over 'error-plagued' AI-assisted ruling"]

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe finit dans le vert, le risque d'un resserrement monétaire recule
item.description: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en hausse vendredi, l'inflation modérée des indicateurs sous-jacents en Europe et le rapport sur l'emploi américain moins bon que prévu calmant les craintes d'un resserrement monétaire.
item.dc:creator: Coralie Lamarque
item.content:encoded: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en hausse vendredi, l'inflation modérée des indicateurs sous-jacents en Europe et le rapport sur l'emploi américain moins bon que prévu calmant les craintes d'un resserrement monétaire. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) a gagné 0,79% à 7.897,19 points. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) a avancé de 1,13% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a pris 0,32%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) a progressé de 0,94%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,65% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,69%. Sur la semaine, le Stoxx 600 a reculé 1,21% et le CAC 40 a perdu 2,24%. La dernière séance de la semaine a été marquée par la publication de deux indicateurs économiques décisifs pour les perspectives des marchés, à savoir l'inflation préliminaire en zone euro et le rapport sur l'emploi américain. Les données publiées par Eurostat ont montré que la hausse des prix s'accélérait plus que prévu dans la zone euro, l'inflation préliminaire ressortant à 3,8% sur un an en septembre, contre des prévisions à 3,6% et après 3,2% en août. Bien que l'inflation se rapproche davantage du double de l'objectif fixé par Francfort (+2,0%), la hausse modérée des indicateurs sous-jacents indique que les coûts élevés de l'énergie ne sont pas à même de déclencher une spirale inflationniste. Ce constat intervient alors que la présidente de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE), Christine Lagarde, avait déclaré [USN:L6N45K0TV TEXT:"lundi"] qu'une réponse mesurée resterait appropriée pour juguler l'inflation en l'absence d'effets de second tour. De l'autre côté de l'Atlantique, le rapport sur l'emploi aux États-Unis a révélé une chute bien plus importante que prévu de la création d'emplois non-agricoles en septembre, tombant à 29.000 en septembre alors que les attentes tablaient sur 90.000 créations après 133.000 (révisé de 162.000) le mois précédent. Ce mauvais chiffre s'avère toutefois positif pour les perspectives des marchés, leur permettant de tabler que la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed) s'abstiendra d'augmenter une nouvelle fois ses taux lors de sa prochaine réunion, fin octobre. "Décembre reste notre scénario de base pour la prochaine action, même si la récente flambée des rendements, ainsi que toute avancée dans les négociations sur la guerre en Iran d’ici là, pourraient encore remettre en cause un nouveau resserrement monétaire", a déclaré Matthew Ryan, responsable de la stratégie de marché chez Ebury, dans une note. Les marchés bénéficient également du soulagement sur les cours pétroliers après que les dirigeants du G7 sont convenus [USN:S8N3ZZ0DK TEXT:"vendredi"] de libérer jusqu'à 100 millions de barils sous 4 mois afin de lutter contre la crise énergétique mondiale causée par le conflit au Moyen-Orient. VALEURS Lanterne rouge du CAC 40, Kering (PRTP.PA) a perdu 3,22% à la suite des déclarations de la direction aux analystes lors de la conférence préalable à la clôture du troisième trimestre. Ailleurs en Europe, Volvo Cars (VOLCARb.ST) a chuté de 7,35% après [USN:L8N43J0LI TEXT:"avoir émis"] un avertissement concernant ses ventes et sa situation de trésorerie. À WALL STREET Au moment de la clôture en Europe, Wall Street reste dans le vert, le Dow Jones (.DJI) avançant de 0,32%, le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) de 0,67% et le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) de 1,13%. LES INDICATEURS DU JOUR L'indice des prix sous-jacents en zone euro, qui exclut les coûts volatils de l'alimentation, l'énergie, l'alcool et le tabac, [USN:L8N45O0IA TEXT:"ressort à"] +2,5% en septembre, comme anticipé et après 2,4% en août, montrent les données préliminaires d'Eurostat. En plus de la chute de la création d'emplois, le rapport publié par le département du Travail américain [USN:L8N45O0XJ TEXT:"a fait état"] d'une légère hausse surprise du taux de chômage, ressortant à +4,2% en septembre tandis que les économistes interrogés par Reuters tablaient sur +4,1% après le même chiffre en août. CHANGES Le billet vert recule à la suite du rapport sur l'emploi américain. Le dollar perd 0,20% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l'euro gagne 0,16% à 1,1259 dollar . TAUX Le marché obligataire reste sujet à de fortes pressions, en particulier sur les rendements français, face aux inquiétudes sur les finances publiques et au lendemain de la présentation du projet de budget 2027 par le gouvernement français. Le "spread", ou écart de rendement, entre les obligations allemandes et françaises à dix ans se resserre quelque peu, à 140 points de base (pdb), après [USN:L6N45O0ME TEXT:"avoir dépassé"] à mi-séance le seuil des 150 pdb, une première depuis fin 2011. En France, le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans a cédé 0,4 point de base à 4,8620%. Le deux ans a progressé de 1,7 point de base à 3,7356%. Outre-Rhin, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans a grappillé 0,5 point de base à 3,4599%. Le deux ans a pris 1,4 point de base à 3,0637%. Outre-Atlantique, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans avance de 2,6 points de base à 5,2600%. Le deux ans gagne 4,0 points de base à 4,8268%. PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers se maintiennent à la baisse au gré de la libération de réserves de produits pétroliers annoncée par le G7, bien que le Brent ait freiné son recul observé plus tôt pour repasser au dessus des 100 dollars le baril. Le Brent cède 1,84% à 100,43 dollars le baril tandis le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) perd 3,07% à 90,02 dollars. À SUIVRE LUNDI 5 OCTOBRE : [USN:L8N45F1IJ] LA SITUATION SUR LES MARCHÉS (Certaines données peuvent accuser un léger décalage)

item.title: Indian border forces kill two Pakistani civilians, wound one, Pakistani security sources say

item.content:encoded: Indian Border Security Forces shot dead two unarmed Pakistani civilians and wounded a third near the border between India and Pakistan, Pakistani security sources said on Friday.

item.title: Carney plans to visit Turkey this month, sources say
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney plans to visit Turkey this month to meet President Tayyip Erdogan in what would be the first dedicated bilateral visit to the country by a Canadian leader, four sources with knowledge of the visit said.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Spicer, Promit Mukherjee, David Ljunggren
item.content:encoded: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney plans to visit Turkey this month to meet President Tayyip Erdogan in what would be the first dedicated bilateral visit to the country by a Canadian leader, four sources with knowledge of the visit said. One of the sources said Carney and Erdogan could discuss the free-trade talks they launched on the sidelines of a NATO summit in Ankara in July, as well as potential energy and defense cooperation. Canadian and Turkish trade ministers agreed this week to accelerate the talks ahead of the leaders' meeting, two sources said. The visit would mark Carney's latest break with Canadian diplomatic convention as he seeks to reduce the country's reliance on the United States, by far its biggest trading partner, after a collapse in trade talks in August. TRADE WAR Carney has vowed to double Canada's non-US trade over the next decade and has rushed to establish ties with a host of countries, including [USN:P8N3X30AH TEXT:"China"] and [USN:L6N3ZM14R TEXT:"India,"] with which it had past strains. He has focused less on human rights than his predecessors to forge ahead, backed by polls showing strong support among Canadians for his efforts to reinforce the economy in the face of US tariffs. Erdogan, Turkey's leader of 23 years — whom rights groups have criticized for a crackdown on the political opposition since 2024 — seeks new markets and collaboration for the regional military power's burgeoning defense industry. Erdogan says an independent judiciary is probing the opposition and rejects claims it is politically motivated. Turkey, an emerging market economy whose biggest trading partner is the European Union, also seeks partnerships and investment in energy, infrastructure and mining. The sources did not share the dates or agenda of the visit planned later this month. Carney's office and Erdogan's office did not immediately respond to requests for comment. LESS FOCUS ON RIGHTS Western powers have grown [USN:L6N42B0TW TEXT:"relatively silent"] on Turkey's rights record as it has become a leading defense-industrial power and a bulwark against Russian aggression. Since last month, a wave of arrests and restrictions has targeted Turkey's LGBTQ+ community in a probe the government says aims to protect children and family values, but which has drawn [USN:L8N45N15P TEXT:"sharp criticism"] from rights groups and some European officials. No Canadian prime minister is known to have made a standalone bilateral visit to Turkey in recent decades, though they have met Erdogan and other Turkish leaders on the sidelines of multilateral gatherings, including NATO and G20 summits hosted by Turkey. MODEST BILATERAL TRADE At the NATO leaders' summit in July, Carney and Erdogan [USN:FWN43909C TEXT:"formally launched"] negotiations for a free-trade agreement. That month, Turkey agreed to join Canada's [USN:L6N4390SG TEXT:"Defence Security and Resilience Bank"] as one of 10 founding member nations of Carney's multilateral "middle powers" [USN:L6N4330UD TEXT:"bank"]. The two countries' trade ministers met in June and planned to expand cooperation on renewable and nuclear energy, a Canadian government statement said, listing aerospace, defense and security as areas of potential new partnerships. Turkey has held talks with Canadian engineering firm AtkinsRealis ATRL.TO as well as South Korea's Korea Electric Power Corporation and China's State Power Investment Corporation about potentially building its second and third nuclear power plants, and Russia's Rosatom is building its first. An executive at AtkinsRealis, which holds the exclusive license for Canadian-designed CANDU reactors, told Reuters this year that [USN:S8N41X002 TEXT:"it anticipates"] Turkey will complete an early review of its CANDU reactors following an information exchange, which may lead to concrete talks for a plant bid. In a step that helped thaw bilateral ties in 2024, Canada removed weapons-export controls on Turkey, including on optical technology used in drones that Turkey exports to dozens of nations. Yet bilateral trade is small. Turkey accounted for less than 0.3% of Canada's total merchandise trade in 2025, or C$4.34 billion ($3.05 billion), compared with C$1 trillion with the US, Statistics Canada data shows. Canada mainly exports lentils, aircraft and electronics to Turkey, and imports medical devices, fishing vessels, aircraft engines and jewelry. ($1 = 1.4227 Canadian dollars)

item.title: IEA's Birol says oil prices starting to fall after reserve release decision
item.description: Oil prices have started to fall after a decision to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel reserves, International Energy Agency chief Fatih Birol said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Oil prices have started to fall after a decision to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel reserves, International Energy Agency chief Fatih Birol said on Friday. "We took a step today on diesel. We held a meeting with world leaders and announced that we would start releasing 100 million barrels of oil again," Birol said. "Prices are starting to fall." "I hope this will be a beneficial step both for the world and for Turkey," he added. Birol was speaking in Istanbul at a press meeting titled "Financing the Transformation: Turkey on the Road to COP31", hosted by Turkey's Banks Association Chairman Alpaslan Cakar.

item.title: Legal sector outpaced US jobs growth in September
item.description: The US legal sector reached another record employment high in September, even as job growth across the broader economy slowed more than expected last month, according to new figures released Friday by the US Department of Labor.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas
item.content:encoded: The US legal sector reached another record employment high in September, even as job growth across the broader economy [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"slowed more than expected"] last month, according to new figures released Friday by the US Department of Labor. Here are the details: The Bureau of Labor Statistics counted 1,249,000 legal sector jobs in September, including lawyers, paralegals, judges and legal assistants, up 2,000 jobs from August and 7.6% higher than five years earlier US employers overall added just 29,000 jobs last month, the Labor Department reported Friday, fewer than the 90,000 that economists had expected The US finance sector, which is larger and an important source of income for law firms, lost 7,000 jobs last month. That sector has shrunk by 129,000 jobs since peaking in May 2025

item.title: Negócio de carros da Tesla volta à trajetória de crescimento, com entregas superando previsões
item.description: A Tesla está a caminho de encerrar dois anos consecutivos de queda nas vendas, após as entregas do terceiro trimestre superarem as estimativas de Wall Street nesta sexta-feira, com uma recuperação na Europa dando à montadora um caminho de volta ao crescimento sem os incentivos fiscais dos EUA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Tesla (TSLA.O) está a caminho de encerrar dois anos consecutivos de queda nas vendas, após as entregas do terceiro trimestre superarem as estimativas de Wall Street nesta sexta-feira, com uma recuperação na Europa dando à montadora um caminho de volta ao crescimento sem os incentivos fiscais dos EUA. As ações da empresa sediada em Austin, Texas, que perderam cerca de um quinto de seu valor este ano, subiram mais de 5% no início do pregão. Os números sugerem que o principal negócio de automóveis da Tesla pode estar recuperando o fôlego, mesmo com os investidores olhando cada vez mais além das entregas trimestrais para os investimentos do presidente-executivo Elon Musk em inteligência artificial, robôs-táxi e robôs humanoides. A avaliação da fabricante de veículos elétricos em cerca de US$1,40 trilhão depende fortemente dessas ambições de longo prazo, embora a venda de veículos ainda seja sua maior fonte de receita. "Os números expressivos colocam a Tesla no caminho certo para o crescimento das entregas no ano todo, após dois anos de quedas. Aponto o FSD (Full Self-Driving - Direção Autônoma Total) como um diferencial que leva os consumidores a escolherem a Tesla em vez de outras montadoras", disse Seth Goldstein, analista sênior de ações da Morningstar. A Tesla precisa de mais 311.448 entregas para igualar o total do ano passado, número inferior ao de qualquer trimestre desde meados de 2022. Nos Estados Unidos, as vendas da empresa liderada por Musk deveriam cair em relação ao terceiro trimestre recorde do ano passado, após o crédito fiscal federal de US$7.500 para compradores de veículos elétricos expirou no final de setembro de 2025. A Tesla entregou 486.532 veículos no período de julho a setembro, em comparação com a estimativa média dos analistas de 456.896 veículos, de acordo com dados compilados pela Visible Alpha. A demanda parecia forte no início do trimestre, já que o diretor financeiro Vaibhav Taneja disse em julho que a Tesla "encerrou o segundo trimestre com a maior carteira de pedidos desde 2023". Ao contrário do que aconteceu no início deste ano, os analistas elevaram suas previsões para o ano todo, esperando agora 1,82 milhão de entregas em 2026, acima dos 1,65 milhão previstos pelo consenso de junho. Também na sexta-feira, a rival menor Rivian (RIVN.O) superou as estimativas de entregas para o terceiro trimestre e reafirmou sua previsão de entregas para o ano todo. A Tesla divulgará seus resultados trimestrais em 21 de outubro, após o fechamento do mercado. RECUPERAÇÃO DA EUROPA Após a queda do ano passado na Europa, causada em parte pela reação negativa às políticas de Musk e em parte por concorrentes chineses mais baratos, os registros na UE aumentaram cerca de dois terços no período de janeiro a agosto em comparação com o ano anterior, de acordo com a Associação Europeia de Fabricantes de Automóveis. A recuperação das vendas da Tesla na Europa ganhou força no terceiro trimestre, com forte crescimento nos registros na França e na Dinamarca e ganhos mais amplos em setembro, impulsionados por incentivos governamentais, comparações mais fáceis com o ano anterior e crescente interesse do consumidor em veículos elétricos. Analistas esperam que a implementação gradual do software Full Self-Driving (FSD) da empresa na Europa impulsione ainda mais as vendas, visto que o FSD já foi aprovado em oito países. Sua frota de serviços de robotáxi é menor que a Waymo, da Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , que opera serviços comerciais em diversas cidades dos EUA. O serviço de robotáxis da Tesla agora opera sem um supervisor de segurança dentro do veículo no Texas e na Flórida. No mês passado, a empresa adicionou o Cybercab, um veículo especialmente projetado para esse fim, ao seu serviço de robotáxis já existente em Austin. (Por Akash Sriram e Anhata Rooprai)

item.title: 世界食料価格、9月は約4年ぶり高水準 物流混乱や悪天候響く＝ＦＡＯ
item.description:
Gus Trompiz
［パリ ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gus Trompiz

［パリ　２日　ロイター］ - 国連食糧農業機関（ＦＡＯ）が２日発表した９月の世界食料価格指数は１３６．０ポイントと、２０２２年１１月以来、３年１０カ月ぶりの高水準となった。物流の混乱や悪天候が影響し、８月改定値の１３４．０ポイントから上昇した。

エルニーニョ現象が収穫量に影響するとの懸念から、国際的に取引される砂糖の価格は１年半ぶりの高値を付けているほか、ロシアとウクライナの戦闘激化に伴う黒海からの輸出停滞が響き、９月初めには小麦先物価格が約３年ぶりの高値を記録している。

ＦＡＯのチーフエコノミスト、マキシモ・トレロ氏は声明で「ホルムズ海峡や黒海での混乱が気候関連の要因と重なり、エネルギーや輸送、主要食品の価格に上昇圧力がかかっている。広範囲で根強い上昇傾向が見られる」と指摘。「特に輸入国では消費者への食品価格の転嫁が見られるだろう」と警告した。

砂糖価格指数は前月から６．１％、穀物価格は５．１％それぞれ上昇した。黒海で続く輸送の混乱に加え、米産トウモロコシの収穫見通しの引き下げが要因。植物油価格は０．９％上昇。一方、肉類価格は１．１％低下した。

ＦＡＯは別の報告書で、２６年の世界穀物生産量を２９億７９００万トンと予測。過去最高だった２５年に次ぐ水準となる見通しだ。

item.title: Commanders rule out QB Jayden Daniels vs. Colts in London
item.description: The Washington Commanders ruled out quarterback Jayden Daniels for their Sunday game against the Indianapolis Colts in London.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Washington Commanders ruled out quarterback Jayden Daniels for their Sunday game against the Indianapolis Colts in London. The Commanders (1-2) confirmed Friday that Daniels will miss his second straight game with a dislocated left elbow and Marcus Mariota will be under center against the Colts (1-2) at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Washington coach Dan Quinn said he remains optimistic that Daniels could return as soon as the Week 5 home game against the New York Giants. "That's a huge positive step for us and for him," Quinn said Friday. "... Typical of him, he was more ready (to play this week) than you expect. That's just how he is." There had been hope that Daniels, who traveled with the team to England, might make his return against the Colts. Daniels was listed as a limited practice participant on Wednesday and Thursday, participating in individual drills with a brace on his left arm. Mariota threw for three touchdowns last Sunday in Washington's 33-31 home upset of the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks. He completed 19 of 31 passes for 183 yards with three touchdowns and no turnovers. There was good news for Washington on the injury front Friday as linebacker Frankie Luvu (groin) and tight end Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) are expected to return after both missed the past two games. Daniels, 25, has completed 56.9% of his passes for 260 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions in two games this season. Mariota, 32, has connected on 63.8% of his passes for 294 yards, four TDs and no picks in two games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Saudis plan assault on Houthis to break Red Sea chokehold
item.description: Saudi Arabia is planning an offensive against Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen, with options being considered including a coastal push to secure the Red Sea shipping route or an assault on multiple fronts, regional and Western officials told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari, Mubasher Bukhari
item.content:encoded: Saudi Arabia is planning an offensive against Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen, with options being considered including a coastal push to secure the Red Sea shipping route or an assault on multiple fronts, regional and Western officials told Reuters. The operation, expected to be launched in the coming weeks, will by led by Yemeni forces on the ground, which are overseen by Riyadh, and supported by Saudi air strikes, according to six people with knowledge of the preparations. While the US is already providing intelligence to support Riyadh's operations in Yemen, and some regional and European nations are providing mainly defensive military aid to the kingdom, the Saudi allies aren't expected to play a direct role in combat operations, said the people who requested anonymity to discuss security matters. Saudi Arabia entered neighboring Yemen's civil war in 2015 at the head of an Arab coalition in support of the internationally recognised government, which the Houthis had driven out of the capital Sanaa. A truce agreed between the warring parties in 2022 largely held until this year when the Houthis launched [USN:L1N43O02F TEXT:"missile and drone"] attacks on Saudi shipping and oil infrastructure in a spillover from the Iran war. A key objective of the planned Saudi offensive, which hasn't been previously reported, is aimed at reversing the rapid gains made by the Houthis last month when they advanced down the coast and seized control of the Bab el-Mandeb strait, according to the people with knowledge of the plans who include Gulf and Yemeni officials and Western diplomats. The Saudis are considering two possible options for the assault, the Gulf and Yemeni officials said: Either a narrowly focused attack on the area around Bab el-Mandeb or a broader offensive that also includes other synchronized attacks on multiple fronts around Yemen, in the governorates of Al-Bayda, Marib, Taiz and Al-Jawf. More than 100,000 Yemeni troops could be mobilized in the offensive, depending on the scale, the officials all said. Spokespeople for the Saudi and Yemeni governments, the Houthi group and the US military didn't immediately respond to requests for comment about the Saudi plans. Bab el-Mandeb is the southern exit passage of the Red Sea, a key shipping route between the Mediterranean and Asia that's assumed even more importance this year as an [USN:L8N4081EB TEXT:"alternative"] to the Strait of Hormuz, which has been effectively closed by the Iran conflict. Riyadh has concluded it cannot enter new Yemeni peace negotiations with the Houthis while the militants remain in control of Bab el-Mandeb, giving them significant global leverage, the Western diplomats and Gulf official said. The six people with knowledge of the Saudi preparations couldn't give a precise timing for the launch of the offensive, with their estimates ranging from within a week to until after the US midterm elections in early November. Michael Ratney, a former US ambassador to Saudi Arabia, said he expected an offensive to be narrowly focused and certainly more modest in scope than the Saudi-led operation in 2015 that sought to rout the militants. "As much they want to vanquish the Houthis completely, they also need to get back to status quo ante before Houthis controlled territory along Bab el-Mandeb," he added. "Ideally, it would be a fairly limited operation to retake coastal areas and get back to normal maritime traffic." The Houthis have become Iran's most formidable ally in the Middle East since Israel's degradation of Hezbollah in Lebanon over the past three years. A Saudi-directed offensive against the group would mark a new flashpoint in a region engulfed by conflict since the Hamas-led attacks on Israel of October 7, 2023 and the subsequent US-Israeli war on Iran. TRUMP, TURKEY AND PAKISTAN Washington, Saudi Arabia's most powerful ally, is providing military advisers and intelligence including targeting information to support Saudi air operations in Yemen, according to one of the Western diplomats. However, the extent of support may be limited. Reuters has previously reported that US President Donald Trump [USN:P8N3ZN0LL TEXT:"rebuffed"] requests by the de facto Saudi ruler Mohammed bin Salman for direct military support such as air strikes. Turkey and Pakistan, with whom Saudi Arabia signed a joint [USN:L6N4440I6 TEXT:"defence agreement"] last month, have provided military equipment that the kingdom is using in Yemen, Pakistani and regional officials said. Last month, Pakistan sent four cargo planes with equipment including air defence systems, light artillery, drones and anti-drone systems to Aden, the seat of Yemen's Saudi-backed government, a Pakistani government official said. Pakistani military advisers are also on the ground with Saudi counterparts to support Yemeni forces, according to a second Pakistani official, the Gulf official and a Western diplomat. Turkish drones, bought by Saudi Arabia before the current war, have also been deployed over Yemen, they added. One of the kingdom's key concerns in launching a new offensive in Yemen is how to protect its oil facilities and other infrastructure from Houthi drone and missile attacks, according to regional officials who said Riyadh has asked several allies for help with defensive systems. Pakistan has deployed between 30,000 and 40,000 troops to Saudi Arabia to help defend the kingdom's land borders and help with drone and missile interceptions, according to the second Pakistani official, who said the troops arrived in waves beginning last year but also after the recent escalation. Islamabad hasn't made any decision to send troops into Yemen in a fighting capacity, the official said. The Pakistani and Turkish defence ministries didn't respond to requests for comment on their military support for Riyadh. France, meanwhile, [USN:B5N44301E TEXT:"has announced"] it will send defensive systems and troops to Saudi Arabia to help protect the Red Sea port city of Yanbu. FRACTURED YEMENI FORCES Any ground operation inside Yemen will rely on the disparate coalition of Yemeni fighting factions that Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates armed and trained at earlier stages of the civil war when the conflict ground to a bloody stalemate. "Many anti-Houthi forces are still not organised or prepared for the kind of sustained offensive required to push back a disciplined Houthi military force. And they are being tested right now, as the Houthis apply pressure across several fronts at once," said Yemen analyst Mohammed Albasha. Yemeni forces were further fractured last winter when southern fighters backed by the UAE tried to take territory in the east and announce secession plans, leading to their defeat by Saudi-backed fighters after a series of clashes. Ali Shihabi, a Saudi political analyst close to government thinking, cautioned the outcome of any offensive by the Saudis against the Houthis would depend on how ground forces perform. "The priority so far has been to defend the positions on the ground and stabilize the front, but certainly they will be going on the offensive," he said. "Success greatly depends on the quality of the performance of the local forces."

item.title: NY governor attacks law enforcement's handling of 2024 Cornell rape investigation
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul on Friday faulted police and prosecutors for failing to fully investigate an alleged gang rape in 2024 at Cornell University, saying she was "deeply disturbed" by how the incident was handled.
item.dc:creator: Joseph Ax
item.content:encoded: New York Governor Kathy Hochul on Friday faulted police and prosecutors for failing to fully investigate an [USN:L1N45N0UA TEXT:"alleged gang rape"] in 2024 at Cornell University, saying she was "deeply disturbed" by how the incident was handled. Hochul was speaking at a press conference alongside state Attorney General Letitia James, whom she appointed on Thursday night as a [USN:L1N45O00M TEXT:"special prosecutor"] to investigate the allegations. The case has drawn fresh scrutiny after the alleged victim filed a lawsuit accusing fraternity members of raping her while she was intoxicated, prompting widespread outrage over how the matter was handled in 2024. On Monday, Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten said he was [USN:L1N45K0ML TEXT:"reopening"] an investigation, which will now be overseen by James' office. Van Houten has defended his office's decision in 2024 not to pursue charges, saying that the woman's sworn statement to police did not contain allegations that rose to the level of a crime under state law. New York law makes it more difficult to prosecute sexual assault cases in which the victim voluntarily became intoxicated, according to experts and advocates. Some news outlets have reported in recent days that the woman told police unequivocally that she was raped, but that investigators did not include that claim in the sworn statement that was provided to prosecutors. Hochul criticized Cornell police for that omission, while also questioning why Van Houten's office did not interview the woman directly or review the full transcript of her police interview. "This young woman had already endured something that is utterly unspeakable, and then at every turn she was failed by people and institutions with an obligation to protect her," Hochul said. In a statement after the press conference, Van Houten said he supported James' appointment and would cooperate with her investigation. "It has become clear that we were not provided the full picture by the University," he added. "The focus has been and should continue to be on the victims." A Cornell spokesperson said the school supports James' appointment and is "committed to an independent external review of all aspects of how Cornell has handled this case" but did not address Hochul's specific criticisms. In an interview with CNN, the woman's lawyer, Thomas Giuffra, endorsed Hochul's decision to appoint James, saying he had little faith in local prosecutors' handling of the case. Hochul also said she would work with the state legislature to update the state's sexual assault laws and eliminate the [USN:L1N45M14T TEXT:"current distinction"] between victims who voluntarily consumed intoxicants and those given substances without their consent. Several lawmakers have already renewed calls to pass legislation addressing what they described as a loophole in the law. "If someone is too intoxicated to consent, it should not matter whether they chose to use drugs or alcohol," Hochul said.

item.title: Massachusetts governor asks Trump administration to speed natgas pipeline review
item.description: Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey called on the Trump administration to expedite the review of a natural gas pipeline that a unit of Canadian energy firm Enbridge is developing in New England.
item.dc:creator: Scott Disavino
item.content:encoded: Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey called on the Trump administration to expedite the review of a natural gas pipeline that a unit of Canadian energy firm Enbridge (ENB.TO) is developing in New England. After opposing most new fossil fuel projects over the past decade or so, several states in the US Northeast region have become more accepting of fossil fuel projects in recent years in an effort to help reduce soaring consumer energy bills. Healey called on the Trump administration on Thursday to expedite federal review of the expansion of the Algonquin Gas Transmission pipeline, known as the Reliable Affordable Resilient Enhancement (RARE) project, that she said US President Donald Trump has previously supported. The project is expected to provide gas supply to 600,000 customers and lower gas bills by $40 million each year. The additional gas supply from the RARE project is expected to reduce reliance on higher-cost imported liquefied natural gas (LNG) from US energy firm Constellation Energy's (CEG.O) Everett LNG import terminal in Massachusetts , the governor said. "I’ve been clear that we need to bring more energy supply into Massachusetts with an all-of-the-above approach that includes solar, wind, storage, nuclear, geothermal, hydro and gas,” Healey said. Enbridge said on its website that it was targeting a 2028 in-service date for the RARE project, which will expand capacity by around 75 million cubic feet per day. Algonquin transports roughly 3.1 billion cubic feet per day (bcfd) of gas through 1,131 miles (1,820 kilometers) of pipe in New Jersey , New York and New England. One billion cubic feet of gas can supply about 5 million US homes for a day. In January, the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities (DPU) approved two 10-year agreements between units of New England energy company Eversource Energy (ES.N) and Algonquin to deliver new gas supplies to customers. The RARE project is currently undergoing federal environmental review through the US Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, the governor said.

item.title: Anthropic alerta que atitudes do governo dos EUA podem prejudicar laços com clientes, mostra prospecto de IPO
item.description: A Anthropic alertou que a postura do governo dos Estados Unidos em relação à empresa e sua tecnologia pode ter implicações mais amplas para seus negócios, incluindo seus relacionamentos com clientes e parceiros comerciais, de acordo com o prospecto de IPO visto pela Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Anthropic alertou que a postura do governo dos Estados Unidos em relação à empresa e sua tecnologia pode ter implicações mais amplas para seus negócios, incluindo seus relacionamentos com clientes e parceiros comerciais, de acordo com o prospecto de IPO visto pela Reuters. As empresas costumam alertar que mudanças nas políticas podem afetar seus negócios, especialmente as contratadas do governo. Por exemplo, a SpaceX (SPCX.O) , em seu prospecto de IPO, afirmou que manter um relacionamento sólido com agências governamentais dos EUA é fundamental para seus negócios e alertou que qualquer deterioração nesses relacionamentos poderia prejudicar materialmente sua capacidade de manter os negócios existentes e conquistar novas oportunidades. A divulgação da Anthropic parece mais abrangente, sugerindo que a percepção do governo sobre a empresa e sua conduta pode ir além de suas relações diretas, afetando clientes, parceiros, outros relacionamentos comerciais — e até mesmo a civilização. O documento alerta que a IA avançada pode representar "riscos catastróficos ou existenciais para a humanidade", um aviso extraordinário vindo de uma empresa que planeja um IPO e que pode ser avaliada em US$2 trilhões pela capacidade da empresa de lucrar com a mesma tecnologia. A empresa afirmou que a receita proveniente de contratos com agências governamentais representa menos de 1% de sua receita anual. A companhia tornou-se um foco de preocupação em relação aos riscos decorrentes do rápido avanço, da intensa competição global e da supervisão limitada das tecnologias de IA. A questão mais ampla da segurança da IA ganhou destaque recentemente com o apelo do presidente-executivo da Anthropic, Dario Amodei, para que a indústria desacelere seu desenvolvimento, após repetidos relatos de atividades de hackers por parte dos chamados agentes autônomos de IA desonestos. No último domingo, Amodei jantou com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, em meio a crescentes apelos por uma maior regulamentação da IA. Trump rejeitou amplamente esses apelos, embora a Comissão Federal de Comércio esteja conduzindo uma investigação em todo o setor de empresas de IA, incluindo a Anthropic, informou a Reuters na quarta-feira. No prospecto, a Anthropic citou diversas interações com o governo dos EUA ao longo do último ano como exemplos de ações que poderiam prejudicar seus negócios. O documento afirma que, em fevereiro, o presidente ordenou que as agências federais parassem de usar os modelos da empresa e que o Departamento de Defesa dos EUA classificou a Anthropic como um risco para a segurança nacional em sua cadeia de suprimentos. "A empresa pode sofrer perdas significativas de receita ou interrupções nos negócios atribuíveis a esses eventos", disse a Anthropic. A Anthropic também afirmou que, em junho, o Departamento de Comércio dos EUA impôs restrições de exportação em todo o mundo aos seus modelos Fable 5 e Mythos 5, o que levou a empresa a desativar os modelos para todos os clientes a fim de garantir a conformidade. Embora o Departamento de Comércio tenha posteriormente revogado essas restrições e a Anthropic tenha reimplantado os modelos, a empresa alertou que ações semelhantes poderiam ocorrer no futuro. Tais medidas podem resultar em "danos significativos à reputação, incluindo cobertura negativa da mídia, escrutínio público e percepções negativas entre clientes, parceiros, funcionários e investidores atuais e potenciais", independentemente do resultado final. A empresa acrescentou que a venda para agências governamentais acarreta riscos adicionais, incluindo mudanças na visão do governo sobre a Anthropic ou sua tecnologia. (Por Echo Wang e Milana Vinn)

item.title: 米沿岸警備隊、キューバへ向かう燃料輸送船を拿捕 石油禁輸措置続く中
item.description:
Katharine Jackson
[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Katharine Jackson

[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米沿岸警備隊は２日、燃料を積んでキューバに向かっていた大型貨物船を拿捕（だほ）したと発表した。トランプ米政権によるキューバへの厳しい石油禁輸措置が続く中での動きとなる。

沿岸警備隊によると、同船は９月５日、キューバとメキシコの間のカリブ海で、当局の追跡を逃れようと航行していたところを拿捕された。ニューヨーク・タイムズ紙は、同船の全長が約９１メートルであると報じた。

沿岸警備隊は声明で「同船は燃料を積載してキューバへ向かっていた。ダークフリート（闇の船団）の間で一般的な手口を用いていたとみられる」と説明した。

声明によると、沿岸警備隊の部隊が同船に乗り込み、メキシコへ護送した。メキシコ海軍の検査チームは「同船のバラストタンク内に大量の燃料があることを確認した。また、違法な燃料が入っているとみられる複数のコンテナも積載していた」としている。

ただ、当局がどのように燃料がキューバ向けだと把握したか、また同船がどれだけの燃料を積載していたかには言及していない。

トランプ政権はキューバの体制転換を目標としていると公言している。今年に入って発動された米国による石油封鎖を受け、同国は燃料不足や停電など深刻な打撃を受けている。

item.title: G7-Staaten geben bis zu 100 Millionen Barrel Diesel und Rohöl frei
item.description: Die G7-Staaten haben sich auf die Freigabe von bis zu 100 Millionen Barrel Diesel und Rohöl geeinigt, um die angespannten Energiemärkte zu entlasten. Die koordinierte Freigabe über die Internationale Energieagentur (IEA) soll unverzüglich anlaufen und über einen Zeitraum von vier Monaten erfolgen, wie die G7 in einer gemeinsamen Erklärung am Freitag mitteilten. Zudem ist eine vorgezogene, erhebliche Freigabe von Diesel innerhalb der ersten 20 Tage durch die G7-Mitglieder und ihre Partner geplant.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die G7-Staaten haben sich auf die Freigabe von bis zu 100 Millionen Barrel Diesel und Rohöl geeinigt, um die angespannten Energiemärkte zu entlasten. Die koordinierte Freigabe über die Internationale Energieagentur (IEA) soll unverzüglich anlaufen und über einen Zeitraum von vier Monaten erfolgen, wie die G7 in einer gemeinsamen Erklärung am Freitag mitteilten. Zudem ist eine vorgezogene, erhebliche Freigabe von Diesel innerhalb der ersten 20 Tage durch die G7-Mitglieder und ihre Partner geplant. Der französische Präsident Emmanuel Macron erklärte, die G7-Staaten hätten vereinbart, ihre Maßnahmen weiter abzustimmen, um die Öllieferungen durch die Straße von Hormus zu sichern. Zu der Gruppe gehören neben Frankreich die USA, Deutschland, Großbritannien, Italien, Kanada und Japan. In ihrer Erklärung bekräftigten die Staats- und Regierungschefs der G7-Staaten ihre Verpflichtung, auf Exportbeschränkungen für Energie und Energieträger untereinander zu verzichten. Sie riefen zudem alle Produzenten auf, keine Verbote zu verhängen, die die Spannungen auf den Märkten verschärfen könnten. Dies gilt als Signal an die USA, die zuvor mit einem einseitigen Exportverbot für Diesel gedroht hatten. Die G7 forderten die IEA auf, die sofortige und vollständige Umsetzung der im März vereinbarten Verpflichtungen zu überwachen. Zudem wollen die G7-Staaten die Wartungspläne ihrer Raffinerien untereinander abstimmen. Die Staats- und Regierungschefs verurteilten in der Erklärung erneut die Angriffe des Iran auf seine Nachbarstaaten und bekräftigten ihr Festhalten an den Sanktionen gegen Russland.

item.title: Tesla verkauft mehr Autos als erwartet - Aktie steigt
item.description: Der US-Autobauer Tesla hat dank einer steigenden Nachfrage in Europa im Sommer mehr Autos verkauft als erwartet. Insgesamt seien 486.532 Fahrzeuge an die Kunden ausgeliefert worden, teilte das Unternehmen am Freitag mit. Das sind zwar rund 11.000 Fahrzeuge weniger als vor Jahresfrist. Analysten hatten aber nach Daten von Visible Alpha im Schnitt mit lediglich 456.896 Autos gerechnet. An der Börse kamen die Zahlen gut an: Die Aktie legte im US-Handel um 4,3 Prozent zu.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der US-Autobauer Tesla (TSLA.O) hat dank einer steigenden Nachfrage in Europa im Sommer mehr Autos verkauft als erwartet. Insgesamt seien 486.532 Fahrzeuge an die Kunden ausgeliefert worden, teilte das Unternehmen am Freitag mit. Das sind zwar rund 11.000 Fahrzeuge weniger als vor Jahresfrist. Analysten hatten aber nach Daten von Visible Alpha im Schnitt mit lediglich 456.896 Autos gerechnet. An der Börse kamen die Zahlen gut an: Die Aktie legte im US-Handel um 4,3 Prozent zu. "Die starken Zahlen bringen Tesla auf die Spur, nach zwei Jahren mit Rückgängen im Gesamtjahr wieder Wachstum zu schaffen", sagte Morningstar-Analyst Seth Goldstein. Er verwies auf das Fahrerassistenzsystem FSD, das Verbraucher dazu animiere, einen Tesla zu fahren. Für das Gesamtjahr fehlt dem Unternehmen von Elon Musk damit nur noch ein Absatz von gut 300.000 Fahrzeugen, um auf Jahressicht wieder Wachstum zu schaffen.

item.title: Trump: Europa gibt "riesige Menge" an Dieselreserven frei
item.description: Die europäischen Staaten haben sich nach Angaben von US-Präsident Donald Trump auf die Freigabe erheblicher Dieselreserven geeinigt. "Europa hat soeben zugestimmt, riesige Mengen seiner gut gefüllten Dieselbestände freizugeben", schrieb Trump am Freitag auf der Plattform Truth Social. Die Freigabe werde unverzüglich anlaufen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die europäischen Staaten haben sich nach Angaben von US-Präsident Donald Trump auf die Freigabe erheblicher Dieselreserven geeinigt. "Europa hat soeben zugestimmt, riesige Mengen seiner gut gefüllten Dieselbestände freizugeben", schrieb Trump am Freitag auf der Plattform Truth Social. Die Freigabe werde unverzüglich anlaufen. Die Kraftstoffpreise in den USA sind vor den Kongresswahlen im November stetig gestiegen. Zuvor hatten die EU-Staaten Insidern zufolge über einen entsprechenden französischen Vorschlag beraten, eine endgültige Entscheidung jedoch von der Zusicherung Washingtons abhängig gemacht, auf ein einseitiges Exportverbot für Diesel zu verzichten.

item.title: Bilger unzufrieden mit Bahnsanierung - "Konzept hat so nicht funktioniert"
item.description: Bundesverkehrsminister Steffen Bilger hat spürbare Verbesserungen für Bahnkunden innerhalb von drei Jahren in Aussicht gestellt und den Druck auf die Deutsche Bahn(DBN.UL) erhöht. "Diese spürbare Verbesserung will ich erreichen", sagte der CDU-Politiker in einem am Freitag veröffentlichten Interview mit der ARD. Bis 2029 solle die Pünktlichkeit im Fernverkehr bei 70 Prozent liegen. Dieses Ziel sei durchaus ambitioniert, "wenn man sieht, dass wir die letzten Monate bei etwas mehr als 50 Prozent Pünktlichkeit im Fernverkehr waren". Zu einem positiven Bahnerlebnis gehörten zudem Sicherheit, Sauberkeit und eine bessere Kundenkommunikation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundesverkehrsminister Steffen Bilger hat spürbare Verbesserungen für Bahnkunden innerhalb von drei Jahren in Aussicht gestellt und den Druck auf die Deutsche Bahn(DBN.UL) erhöht. "Diese spürbare Verbesserung will ich erreichen", sagte der CDU-Politiker in einem am Freitag veröffentlichten Interview mit der ARD. Bis 2029 solle die Pünktlichkeit im Fernverkehr bei 70 Prozent liegen. Dieses Ziel sei durchaus ambitioniert, "wenn man sieht, dass wir die letzten Monate bei etwas mehr als 50 Prozent Pünktlichkeit im Fernverkehr waren". Zu einem positiven Bahnerlebnis gehörten zudem Sicherheit, Sauberkeit und eine bessere Kundenkommunikation. Bilger äußerte sich erneut unzufrieden mit dem bisherigen Konzept der sogenannten Korridorsanierungen, bei denen wichtige Strecken für die Instandsetzung komplett gesperrt werden. Das Versprechen, dass die Abschnitte danach störungsfrei befahren werden könnten, sei zu oft nicht eingehalten worden. Als Beispiel nannte er die bis zum Sommer sanierte Strecke Hamburg-Berlin. Dort habe es danach "eine Pünktlichkeit von 25 Prozent" gegeben. "Da muss man erkennen, dass das Konzept so nicht funktioniert hat." Man arbeite mit der Bahn an einem neuen Konzept und er werde bald einen Vorschlag machen, betonte Bilger. Derzeit werde mit der Bahn über eine neue sogenannte Leistungsvereinbarung verhandelt, sagte der Minister weiter. "Da geht es darum, wie viel Mittel wir für was in den kommenden fünf Jahren zur Verfügung stellen." Dabei gehe es um mehr als 80 Milliarden Euro. Dies sei doppelt so viel wie in den vergangenen fünf Jahren. "Damit verbinden wir die Erwartung, dass es spürbar besser wird in unserer Infrastruktur." Das Geld müsse effizient eingesetzt werden. Um die Klimaziele im Verkehr zu erreichen, setzt Bilger neben der Bahn auf die Elektromobilität. Er kündigte jedoch an, die Kaufprämie für E-Autos nach 2029 nicht verlängern zu wollen. In vielen Fällen sei der Kauf eines E-Autos mittlerweile günstiger als der eines Verbrenners. "Und deswegen braucht es aus meiner Sicht in Zukunft keine Förderung des Kaufs von Elektroautos mehr." Die Mittel sollten stattdessen verstärkt in den Ausbau der Ladeinfrastruktur fließen. Zudem kündigte Bilger ein Konzept für einfacheres Laden und mehr Preistransparenz an den Ladesäulen an.

item.title: Zinshoffnungen nach US-Jobdaten geben Wall Street Auftrieb
item.description: Überraschend schwache Arbeitsmarktdaten haben die Hoffnung der US-Anleger auf eine Zinspause der US-Notenbank genährt und damit die Kurse an der Wall Street angeschoben. Der Dow-Jones-Index der Standardwerte und der breiter gefasste S&P 500 notierten zur Eröffnung am Freitag jeweils rund ein Prozent höher bei 51.297 und 7744 Punkten. Der Index der Technologiebörse Nasdaq rückte um rund 1,5 Prozent auf 27.266 Zähler vor.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Überraschend schwache [USN:L8N45O10H TEXT:"Arbeitsmarktdaten"] haben die Hoffnung der US-Anleger auf eine Zinspause der US-Notenbank genährt und damit die Kurse an der Wall Street angeschoben. Der Dow-Jones-Index (.DJI) der Standardwerte und der breiter gefasste S&P 500 (.SPX) notierten zur Eröffnung am Freitag jeweils rund ein Prozent höher bei 51.297 und 7744 Punkten. Der Index der Technologiebörse Nasdaq (.IXIC) rückte um rund 1,5 Prozent auf 27.266 Zähler vor. Unter dem Strich entstanden im September in den USA nur 29.000 Arbeitsplätze außerhalb der Landwirtschaft, wie aus dem Bericht der Regierung hervorgeht. Von der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters befragte Experten hatten mit 90.000 Stellen gerechnet. "Die schwächeren Arbeitsmarktdaten sind merkwürdigerweise eine gute Nachricht für die Aktienmärkte", sagte Todd Schoenberger, Investmentchef bei CrossCheck Management. Die Zahlen nährten die Hoffnung der Anleger, dass die Fed bei Zinserhöhungen langsamer vorgeht. Die Währungshüter versuchen, mit straffer Geldpolitik die Inflation einzudämmen und den heiß gelaufenen Arbeitsmarkt abzukühlen. Für Gesprächsstoff bei den Einzelwerten sorgte unter anderem Nike (NKE.N) mit einem Kursrutsch von rund 7,5 Prozent. Der Sportartikelhersteller kommt nicht aus der Krise. Vorstandschef Elliott Hill verpasst dem weltgrößten Sportartikelhersteller deshalb das nächste [USN:L8N45O0GA TEXT:"Sparprogramm"] mit weiteren Stellenstreichungen.

item.title: Regierungskreise: Bund leitet Reprivatisierung des Gaskonzerns Sefe ein
item.description: Der Bund treibt die Reprivatisierung des verstaatlichten Gaskonzerns Sefe nach Angaben aus Kreisen des Wirtschaftsministeriums voran. "Die Bundesregierung hat den Bewerbungsprozess für Kanzleien und Investmentbanker gestartet", sagte ein Regierungsvertreter am Freitag. Insidern zufolge wird die Investment-Bank Lazard den Prozess begleiten. Demnach soll der Verkauf Anfang 2027 beginnen. Ein Börsengang wurde als unwahrscheinlich bezeichnet. Der Bund hatte die ehemalige Gazprom-Tochter nach dem russischen Einmarsch in die Ukraine mit rund sechs Milliarden Euro gerettet und verstaatlicht. Die "Börsen-Zeitung" berichtete, der Wert des Unternehmens mit Sitz in Berlin werde nun auf eben diese Summe geschätzt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Bund treibt die Reprivatisierung des verstaatlichten Gaskonzerns Sefe nach Angaben aus Kreisen des Wirtschaftsministeriums voran. "Die Bundesregierung hat den Bewerbungsprozess für Kanzleien und Investmentbanker gestartet", sagte ein Regierungsvertreter am Freitag. Insidern zufolge wird die Investment-Bank Lazard den Prozess begleiten. Demnach soll der Verkauf Anfang 2027 beginnen. Ein Börsengang wurde als unwahrscheinlich bezeichnet. Der Bund hatte die ehemalige Gazprom-Tochter nach dem russischen Einmarsch in die Ukraine mit rund sechs Milliarden Euro gerettet und verstaatlicht. Die "Börsen-Zeitung" berichtete, der Wert des Unternehmens mit Sitz in Berlin werde nun auf eben diese Summe geschätzt. Eine Sprecherin des Wirtschaftsministeriums wollte sich zum erwarteten Preis nicht äußern, sagte aber: "Dass es einen Reprivatisierungsprozess geben wird, ist auch durch den Rahmen, den die Kommission bei den Genehmigungsentscheidungen gegeben hat, klar. Die Bundesregierung wird im Reprivatisierungsprozess der Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und Europas Rechnung tragen." Sefe erklärte, man mache grundsätzlich keine Angaben zu Beratungsmandaten im Rahmen der Privatisierung. Geplant ist laut "Börsen-Zeitung" ein zweigleisiges Verfahren, das entweder in einen Verkauf oder theoretisch auch in einen Börsengang münden könnte. In diesem Zuge solle eine Kapitalerhöhung bis zu zwei Milliarden Euro für den Ausbau des Infrastrukturgeschäfts einspielen. Das Interesse potenzieller Investoren halte sich jedoch bislang in Grenzen. Die finanzielle Erholung von Sefe sei weniger weit fortgeschritten als beim Konkurrenten Uniper (UN0k.DE) , der derzeit ebenfalls privatisiert wird. Sefe steht für "Securing Energy for Europe" und ist der mit Abstand größte Gasimporteur in Deutschland. Das Importvolumen ist etwa doppelt so groß wie das von Uniper. Das Unternehmen spielt damit eine zentrale Rolle für die Versorgungssicherheit. Im Jahr 2025 erzielte Sefe mit knapp 2200 Beschäftigten einen Umsatz von rund 15,5 Milliarden Euro.

item.title: US-Jobmarkt schwächelt - "Mehr ein Ausrutscher als ein neuer Trend"
item.description: Mit einem unerwartet niedrigen Stellenaufbau hat der US-Arbeitsmarkt für eine negative Überraschung gesorgt. Unter dem Strich entstanden im September nur 29.000 Arbeitsplätze außerhalb der Landwirtschaft, wie aus dem am Freitag veröffentlichten Job-Bericht der Regierung hervorgeht. Von der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters befragte Experten hatten mit mehr als dem Dreifachen dieser Zahl gerechnet. Auch waren im August nach revidierten Daten nur 133.000 Arbeitsplätze entstanden, anstatt der zunächst gemeldeten 162.000 Jobs. Die Arbeitslosenquote stieg zudem im September auf 4,2 Prozent. Hier hatten Experten mit einem Verharren auf dem Vormonatswert gerechnet.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mit einem unerwartet niedrigen Stellenaufbau hat der US-Arbeitsmarkt für eine negative Überraschung gesorgt. Unter dem Strich entstanden im September nur 29.000 Arbeitsplätze außerhalb der Landwirtschaft, wie aus dem am Freitag veröffentlichten Job-Bericht der Regierung hervorgeht. Von der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters befragte Experten hatten mit mehr als dem Dreifachen dieser Zahl gerechnet. Auch waren im August nach revidierten Daten nur 133.000 Arbeitsplätze entstanden, anstatt der zunächst gemeldeten 162.000 Jobs. Die Arbeitslosenquote stieg zudem im September auf 4,2 Prozent. Hier hatten Experten mit einem Verharren auf dem Vormonatswert gerechnet. "Das Ganze dürfte mehr ein Ausrutscher als ein neuer Trend sein", so die Einschätzung von Alexander Krüger, Chefvolkswirt der Bank Bethmann HAL. Wahrscheinlich werde das schwache Ergebnis mit dem nächsten Bericht schon wieder ausgebügelt. Der Anstieg der Arbeitslosenquote sei kaum der Rede wert. Das Niveau gilt weiter als niedrig und entspricht quasi Vollbeschäftigung. Es wird auch deshalb niedrig gehalten, da Verrentungen und das harte Vorgehen der Regierung von US-Präsident Donald Trump gegen Einwanderung das Arbeitskräfteangebot verringern. "KEINE NOTWENDIGKEIT FÜR AGGRESSIVE ZINSERHÖHUNGEN" Die US-Notenbank Federal Reserve soll für Vollbeschäftigung und stabile Preise sorgen und achtet somit genau auf die Jobdaten. Sie hat den Leitzins zuletzt auf die neue Spanne von 3,75 bis 4,0 Prozent angehoben. Sie stemmte sich damit gegen den Inflationsschub - eine Folge des Iran-Krieges und der damit stark gestiegenen Ölpreise. Die Notenbank bescheinigte dem Arbeitsmarkt zugleich Mitte September, dass der Beschäftigungszuwachs mit dem Wachstum der Erwerbsbevölkerung Schritt gehalten habe. Einer Faustregel von Volkswirten zufolge muss die Wirtschaft dafür monatlich zwischen 50.000 und 80.000 Arbeitsplätze schaffen. Der jüngste Stellenaufbau ist damit deutlich zu niedrig. Doch handelt es sich dabei zunächst nur um eine Momentaufnahme. Der Chef des Fed-Bezirks New York, John [USN:L8N45L2EW TEXT:"Williams"], hat jüngst erklärt, er sehe derzeit keine Eile für eine weitere Verschärfung der Geldpolitik. "Der Arbeitsmarktbericht wird die Fed in ihrem Ausblick moderater Zinsanhebungen bestätigen", sagte der Chefvolkswirt der VP Bank, Thomas Gitzel. Die Projektionen der Notenbankmitglieder zeigten eine weitere Zinsanhebung im laufenden Jahr an: "Die Notwendigkeit für aggressive Zinsanhebungen lässt sich jedenfalls aus dem heute veröffentlichten Wasserstandsbericht des US-Jobmarktes nicht ableiten." Die Hoffnung auf eine eher moderat ausfallende Straffung der Geldpolitik trieb die Futures für die wichtigsten US-Indizes um jeweils rund ein Prozent nach oben. Anleger griffen auch bei den US-Staatsanleihen zu, was die Renditen zehnjähriger Bonds auf 5,176 Prozent nach zuvor rund 5,240 Prozent drückte. Der Dollar-Index (.DXY) gab 0,2 Prozent auf 101,882 Punkte nach.

item.title: WEG vê crescimento retornando apoiado por aumento de capacidade
item.description: A WEG deve retomar crescimento neste semestre, com a ampliação da capacidade produtiva do grupo, disse o diretor financeiro, André Luís Rodrigues, nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A WEG (WEGE3.SA) deve retomar crescimento neste semestre, com a ampliação da capacidade produtiva do grupo, disse o diretor financeiro, André Luís Rodrigues, nesta sexta-feira. Em apresentação da empresa aos investidores, o CFO do grupo destacou que o crescimento deve ocorrer a partir dos investimentos para ampliação das fábricas e principalmente com a contribuição do segmento de transformadores e a internacionalização dos negócios. "Graças a esses investimentos nós vamos destravar o que hoje limita o nosso crescimento, que é a capacidade produtiva a partir de 2026 e 2027", acrescentou. De acordo com o vice-presidente de automação e sistemas, Manfred Johann, o grupo tem observado demanda crescente no negócio de data centers e espera ter um portfólio "extremamente robusto" até 2030, período em que prevê que a carteira de produtos esteja completa para o segmento. Embora não tenha declarado quais tipos de produtos são esperados para os próximos anos, o executivo afirmou que certas tecnologias não estão disponíveis no mercado hoje em dia. Já o vice-presidente de energia João Gualberto da Silva disse que os investimentos devem levar o grupo a alcançar uma produção de 50 geradores por dia até o final de 2029.

item.title: Autoridades israelíes interrogarán al copiloto del vuelo de flydubai, dice una fuente
item.description: Las autoridades israelíes interrogarán al copiloto que, presuntamente, intentó estrellar un vuelo comercial de pasajeros procedente de Dubái y con destino a Tel Aviv, dijo una fuente al corriente de la investigación.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: Las autoridades israelíes interrogarán al copiloto que, presuntamente, intentó estrellar un vuelo comercial de pasajeros procedente de Dubái y con destino a Tel Aviv, dijo una fuente al corriente de la investigación. El miércoles se evitó una catástrofe en el vuelo FZ1073 de flydubai después de que los pasajeros y la tripulación redujeron al copiloto, quien había apuñalado al capitán en lo que, según las autoridades israelíes, fue un aparente intento de estrellar el avión, que transportaba a más de 170 pasajeros y tripulantes. Una tripulación de pilotos de reserva de flydubai que viajaba en el vuelo aterrizó el avión en el aeropuerto de Tabuk, en el noroeste de Arabia Saudita, donde las autoridades saudíes detuvieron al copiloto. El copiloto fue trasladado el jueves a los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, donde, según la fuente, se esperaba que las autoridades israelíes lo interrogaran. La fuente se negó a precisar qué organismo o autoridad israelí participaría en el interrogatorio. Al ser preguntado sobre si las autoridades israelíes interrogarían al copiloto, un funcionario del Gobierno israelí dijo a Reuters que los investigadores israelíes participarían en la investigación dirigida por los Emiratos Árabes Unidos junto con las autoridades emiratíes, con el fin de determinar qué ocurrió y examinar los motivos y los antecedentes del sospechoso. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre si las autoridades israelíes interrogarían al copiloto. En sus primeras declaraciones públicas sobre el incidente, el presidente ejecutivo de flydubai, Ghaith Al Ghaith, dijo el viernes que las autoridades estaban llevando a cabo una investigación oficial, con el apoyo de la aerolínea, tras lo que describió como un "incidente de seguridad" en la cabina de mando. "Es importante que dejemos que este proceso aclare los hechos", dijo en un comunicado escrito, reconociendo que había "muchas preguntas" sobre lo ocurrido en el vuelo FZ1073. La agencia estatal de noticias de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos informó el jueves de que las autoridades emiratíes habían abierto una investigación con el fin de esclarecer las circunstancias y los motivos, y determinar "si el incidente estaba relacionado con alguna actividad o propósito terrorista, o si implicaba una planificación o dirección previa". MOTIVO AÚN POR DETERMINAR El primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, dijo el viernes que Israel estaba investigando si el copiloto había actuado bajo las órdenes de alguien, y advirtió en un comunicado en video difundido por su oficina que quienquiera que estuviera implicado pagaría un "alto precio". La mayoría de los pasajeros a bordo eran ciudadanos israelíes. Netanyahu dijo el jueves que el copiloto, a quien ha identificado como ciudadano omaní, había sido sometido a un adoctrinamiento islamista radical y tenía claras intenciones suicidas, pero que, hasta el momento, no se había determinado el motivo de sus actos. Israel no mantiene relaciones diplomáticas oficiales con Omán, y Netanyahu ha señalado que a los pilotos de esos países no se les permite operar vuelos con destino a Israel. No está claro cómo llegó a ser asignado el copiloto al vuelo con destino a Tel Aviv. La aeronave cayó unos 16.625 pies (5.000 metros) en poco más de 30 segundos mientras sobrevolaba Arabia Saudita en su trayecto desde los Emiratos Árabes Unidos a Israel, según datos del rastreador de vuelos Flightradar24. La ruta es muy popular entre los israelíes. EL CAPITÁN ES ACLAMADO COMO HÉROE La identidad del copiloto no se ha revelado públicamente, salvo su nacionalidad. El capitán que fue apuñalado ha sido identificado como el ciudadano indio Smit Machchhar, quien ha sido aclamado como héroe por Netanyahu y por el primer ministro indio, Narendra Modi. Las autoridades de Omán no han hecho declaraciones sobre el incidente. El incidente ha agravado los temores en materia de seguridad en Israel a pocas semanas de las elecciones del 27 de octubre, las primeras elecciones generales desde los ataques liderados por Hamás el 7 de octubre de 2023, en las que la seguridad de Israel ocupa un lugar destacado en la campaña electoral. Estados Unidos e Israel lanzaron ataques contra Irán en febrero, en una guerra que se extendió rápidamente al Golfo y al Líbano, donde Israel ha estado luchando contra el grupo militante Hezbolá, respaldado por Irán. Desde que fue objeto de ataques por parte de Irán este año, los Emiratos Árabes Unidos han reforzado sus relaciones con Israel, con quien establecieron vínculos a raíz de los Acuerdos de Abraham de 2020.

item.title: US-listed ETFs on course for record annual inflows, State Street says
item.description: Inflows into US-listed exchange-traded funds (ETFs) through end-September have already exceeded any full-year total on record and are expected to grow further by year end, according to State Street Investment Management data.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Inflows into US-listed exchange-traded funds (ETFs) through end-September have already exceeded any full-year total on record and are expected to grow further by year end, according to State Street Investment Management data. Year-to-date inflows stood at more than $1.54 trillion as of end of September, topping the annual record of $1.52 trillion set in 2025. Here are the details: State Street Investment Management's global head of research strategists, Matthew Bartolini, expects total ETF inflows by US-listed funds to reach $2.3 trillion by the year end Equity ETFs have led inflows so far this year, taking in more than $1 trillion alone, followed by fixed income products which have taken in over $469 billion Among equity sectors, technology funds have marked the biggest inflows so far this year at over $59 billion, while financials has lost the most to mark outflows of over $3.8 billion On the basis of geography, funds tracking US stocks have taken in the most this year at about $655 billion, followed by funds tracking international developed markets at inflows of $150.4 billion "Investors continue to favor ETFs as their primary tool for allocating capital, building portfolios, and adapting to changing market conditions, while mutual funds remain mired in persistent outflows," said Bartolini As of Friday morning, the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO.P) , the biggest ETF in the world in terms of assets under management, gained over 13% so far this year Enthusiasm for AI and strong earnings pushed US stocks to record highs earlier this year, but inflation fears arising from the US-Iran conflict and soaring bond yields spurred volatility last month

item.title: States, cities sue US agencies over weaker vehicle fuel economy rules
item.description: California, New York and two dozen other states, cities an counties on Friday sued the U.S. Transportation Department over its decision this week to finalize sharply lower vehicle fuel economy standards in a win for gas-powered vehicles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: California, New York and two dozen other states, cities an counties on Friday sued the U.S. Transportation Department over its decision this week to finalize sharply lower vehicle fuel economy standards in a win for gas-powered vehicles. The revised standards seek to reverse former President Joe Biden's push toward greater fuel efficiency and electric vehicles. California Attorney General Rob Bonta said the new rules violate requirements that the standards be set at the maximum feasible level. A separate lawsuit was also filed challenging the new rules by a coalition of environmental and consumer groups.

item.title: Empresas da zona do euro utilizam recursos próprios em IA, diz blog do BCE
item.description: As empresas da zona do euro estão, em sua maioria, utilizando seus próprios recursos para investir em IA e enfrentam barreiras de financiamento, ao contrário de suas contrapartes norte-americanas, que se lançaram em uma onda global de endividamento para financiar sua expansão, segundo dados divulgados pelo Banco Central Europeu (BCE) nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As empresas da zona do euro estão, em sua maioria, utilizando seus próprios recursos para investir em IA e enfrentam barreiras de financiamento, ao contrário de suas contrapartes norte-americanas, que se lançaram em uma onda global de endividamento para financiar sua expansão, segundo dados divulgados pelo Banco Central Europeu (BCE) nesta sexta-feira. Os gigantes da tecnologia dos EUA, frequentemente chamados de “hiperscalers” ou “Sete Magníficos”, estão investindo centenas de bilhões de dólares em rápida expansão, e os empréstimos têm sido tão elevados que estão excluindo outros participantes -- até mesmo governos -- de alguns mercados de dívida. Já a expansão da IA na Europa é mais modesta, e 72% das empresas afirmam que usarão recursos internos, como fluxo de caixa ou lucros retidos, para financiar os investimentos, informou o BCE em uma postagem no blog. Cerca de 16% afirmaram que planejam utilizar empréstimos bancários, enquanto 6% das empresas mencionaram capital próprio e capital de risco.
