Apenas 1% estava considerando títulos de dívida, segundo a postagem no blog, que não representa necessariamente as opiniões do BCE. “O papel limitado do financiamento externo levanta questões críticas sobre possíveis barreiras no ecossistema financeiro da zona do euro”, afirmou o blog, argumentando que as empresas enfrentam obstáculos ao investir em ativos intangíveis. É mais provável que as empresas recorram a financiamento externo quando investem em ativos tangíveis, como hardware ou infraestrutura de dados, já que esses ativos podem ser usados como garantia, acrescentou o blog. “Isso pode indicar possíveis desafios estruturais que limitam o acesso ao financiamento para investimentos em ativos intangíveis”, afirmou o blog. Mais de 80% das empresas afirmaram que planejam utilizar apenas um único instrumento de financiamento, em vez de uma combinação, sendo que se tratava predominantemente de recursos internos.

item.title: VORSCHAU Kopf-an-Kopf-Rennen bei Präsidentschaftswahl in Brasilien
item.description: In Brasilien entscheiden die Menschen am Sonntag in einer Richtungswahl über den künftigen politischen Kurs des größten Landes Lateinamerikas. Bei der Präsidentschaftswahl zeichnet sich ein enges Rennen zwischen dem linksgerichteten Amtsinhaber Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva und seinem konservativen Herausforderer, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, ab. Einer am Donnerstag veröffentlichten Umfrage des Instituts Datafolha zufolge liegt Lula in einer möglichen Stichwahl mit 48 Prozent knapp vor Bolsonaro, der auf 45 Prozent kommt.
item.dc:creator: Oliver Griffin, Luciana Magalhaes
item.content:encoded: In Brasilien entscheiden die Menschen am Sonntag in einer Richtungswahl über den künftigen politischen Kurs des größten Landes Lateinamerikas. Bei der Präsidentschaftswahl zeichnet sich ein enges Rennen zwischen dem linksgerichteten Amtsinhaber Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva und seinem konservativen Herausforderer, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, ab. Einer am Donnerstag veröffentlichten Umfrage des Instituts Datafolha zufolge liegt Lula in einer möglichen Stichwahl mit 48 Prozent knapp vor Bolsonaro, der auf 45 Prozent kommt. In der ersten Runde der Wahl, bei der 13 Kandidaten antreten, führt Lula mit 42 Prozent vor Bolsonaro mit 38 Prozent. Weit abgeschlagen folgen Augusto Cury mit vier Prozent sowie Ronaldo Caiado und Renan Santos mit jeweils drei Prozent. Sollte am Sonntag kein Kandidat mehr als 50 Prozent der gültigen Stimmen erhalten, kommt es am 25. Oktober zur Stichwahl. Lula, eine Ikone der globalen Linken, strebt insgesamt seine vierte Amtszeit an, allerdings mit Unterbrechungen. Sein Herausforderer Flavio Bolsonaro ist der älteste Sohn des ehemaligen rechtsextremen Präsidenten Jair Bolsonaro. Bolsonaro senior war im vergangenen Jahr wegen eines geplanten Staatsstreichs nach seiner Wahlniederlage 2022 verurteilt worden, was unter anderem von US-Präsident Donald Trump als "Hexenjagd" kritisiert wurde. Während des Wahlkampfs warnte Lula vor ausländischer Einmischung und neuen US-Zöllen. Seine Amtszeit war von Spannungen mit Trump geprägt, die Familie Bolsonaro pflegt dagegen traditionell enge Kontakte nach Washington. INNERE SICHERHEIT DOMINIERT DEBATTE Lulas komfortabler Vorsprung aus dem Frühjahr ist im Laufe des Wahlkampfs geschrumpft. Trotz Erfolgen bei der Senkung der Arbeitslosigkeit kämpfen viele Brasilianer mit steigenden Lebenshaltungskosten, hoher Verschuldung und der zunehmenden Macht krimineller Banden. Bei diesem Thema stehen sich zwei gegensätzliche Konzepte gegenüber: Während Bolsonaro den Bau von fünf Hochsicherheitsgefängnissen nach dem Vorbild El Salvadors verspricht, setzt Lula auf internationale Kooperation, lehnt jedoch eine Einstufung der Banden als Terrororganisationen ab. Um unentschlossene Wähler zu gewinnen, die laut einer Quaest-Umfrage vom Montag noch fünf Prozent der Wählerschaft ausmachten, brachte die Regierung zuletzt ein erweitertes Sozialprogramm, Entlastungen für verschuldete Familien sowie Maßnahmen gegen Online-Wetten auf den Weg. Lula steht unter Druck, weil gegen seinen Sohn Fabio Luis wegen mutmaßlicher Einflussnahme ermittelt wird. Überschattet wird die Wahl zudem von einem Korruptionsskandal um die insolvente Banco Master. Das Verfahren wegen eines mutmaßlichen Milliardenbetrugs belastet das gesamte politische Spektrum und führte auch zu Ermittlungen wegen Geldwäsche gegen Senator Bolsonaro.

item.title: PWHL releases schedule, introduces conferences
item.description: The expanded Professional Women's Hockey League unveiled two new six-team conferences and released its 2026-27 schedule on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The expanded Professional Women's Hockey League unveiled two new six-team conferences and released its 2026-27 schedule on Friday. The Eastern Conference features the Boston Fleet, Montreal Victoire, New York Sirens, Ottawa Charge, Toronto Sceptres and a new team, PWHL Hamilton. The Western Conference includes the Minnesota Frost, Seattle Torrent, Vancouver Goldeneyes and three newcomers: PWHL Las Vegas, PWHL Detroit and PWHL San Jose. "With 12 teams, new conferences and more games than ever before, this schedule reflects the PWHL's monumental growth as anticipation builds for our fourth season," said Jayna Hefford, PWHL executive vice president of hockey operations. "The introduction of conferences and an expanded playoff format will deepen rivalries and fuel the competitiveness that makes PWHL action so exciting from the very first puck drop until the Walter Cup is raised." The regular season will begin on Dec. 5 and run through April 18. Each team will play 30 regular-season games -- 18 within the conference and 12 inter-conference contests. Every team will visit every market at least once. Nearly half of the 180 total games will be played on Saturdays or Sundays. There will be a one-week break for the debut of the PWHL All-Star Game on March 7, to be played at Toronto's Scotiabank Arena. The expanded PWHL Walter Cup Playoffs will feature eight teams competing in three rounds, up from the four-team, two-round format in each of the league's first three postseasons. The first round will feature four best-of-three series, followed by two best-of-five conference finals and a best-of-five Walter Cup Finals. The first-place team in each conference at the end of the regular season will be able to select its first-round opponent, choosing between the third- or fourth-place team within their own conference. Montreal is the defending PWHL champion after defeating Ottawa 3-1 in the finals in May. --Field Level Media

item.title: UMass football sells out first game since 2014
item.description: UMass will play Eastern Michigan on Saturday in front of a home sellout crowd for the first time since 2014.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: UMass will play Eastern Michigan on Saturday in front of a home sellout crowd for the first time since 2014. That's according to ESPN, which reported Friday that more than 17,000 fans are expected at McGuirk Alumni Stadium in Amherst for the Mid-American Conference matchup. It's the latest in a string of achievements for the Minutemen under second-year coach Joe Harasymiak, whose team was winless last season but is off to a 4-0 start. The wins include a season-opening, 37-21 victory on the road at Big Ten program Rutgers. The Minutemen have not scored fewer than 35 points in any of their first four games, and they are on track for their first-ever bowl game. They need six wins to qualify for a bowl. Since becoming an FBS program in 2012, UMass has never won more than four games in a season. The team has finished 0-12 once and 1-11 five times. --Field Level Media

item.title: Flydubai dice que investiga el incidente ocurrido en vuelo de Dubái a Tel Aviv
item.description: Flydubai informó el viernes que se está llevando a cabo una investigación oficial exhaustiva sobre un incidente de seguridad ocurrido en la cabina de mando de un vuelo de Dubái a Tel Aviv que fue desviado a Arabia Saudita el 30 de septiembre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Flydubai informó el viernes que se está llevando a cabo una investigación oficial exhaustiva sobre un incidente de seguridad ocurrido en la cabina de mando de un vuelo de Dubái a Tel Aviv que fue desviado a Arabia Saudita el 30 de septiembre. "Es importante que dejemos que este proceso aclare los hechos", dijo el presidente ejecutivo, Ghaith Al Ghaith, en un comunicado.

item.title: Los pedidos industriales de EEUU suben levemente en agosto
item.description: Los nuevos pedidos de productos industriales en Estados Unidos apenas aumentaron en agosto, ya que la fuerte demanda de equipos eléctricos, electrodomésticos y componentes se vio contrarrestada por la debilidad de los pedidos de aviones comerciales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los nuevos pedidos de productos industriales en Estados Unidos apenas aumentaron en agosto, ya que la fuerte demanda de equipos eléctricos, electrodomésticos y componentes se vio contrarrestada por la debilidad de los pedidos de aviones comerciales. Los pedidos industriales subieron un 0,1% tras un repunte del 0,8% en julio, según cifras revisadas a la baja, informó el viernes la Oficina del Censo del Departamento de Comercio. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters habían pronosticado un aumento de los pedidos del 0,1% tras el incremento del 0,9% registrado inicialmente en julio. Los pedidos aumentaron un 6,8% en términos interanuales en agosto. La expansión de las infraestructuras de inteligencia artificial (IA) está impulsando el sector manufacturero, al igual que la reposición de existencias por parte de las empresas para satisfacer la sólida demanda interna. Sin embargo, existe la preocupación de que los segmentos no relacionados con el auge del gasto en IA puedan atravesar dificultades en los próximos meses, ante los obstáculos derivados de la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán, que ha entorpecido las cadenas de suministro y elevado los precios de la energía. Los precios del diésel se encuentran en máximos históricos, y los economistas dicen que la economía podría empezar a notar pronto los efectos. Los aranceles vigentes sobre las importaciones también suponen un riesgo a la baja. Una encuesta del Instituto de Gerencia y Abastecimiento (ISM) publicada el jueves reveló una creciente inquietud entre los fabricantes por la guerra comercial con Canadá. Los pedidos industriales de agosto se vieron frenados por una caída del 4,3% en los pedidos de aeronaves civiles y sus piezas. Los pedidos de carrocerías, piezas y remolques de vehículos de motor aumentaron un 0,8%. Los pedidos de maquinaria se dispararon un 1,1%. Los pedidos de computadores y productos electrónicos se mantuvieron sin cambios, aunque registraron un aumento interanual del 14,7%. Los pedidos de equipos eléctricos, electrodomésticos y componentes se dispararon un 1,1%. La Oficina del Censo también informó que los pedidos de bienes de capital no destinados a la defensa, excluidas las aeronaves —que se consideran un indicador de los planes de gasto empresarial en equipamiento—, se aceleraron un 1,6% en agosto, tal y como se comunicó el mes pasado. Los envíos de estos denominados "bienes de capital básicos" aumentaron un 0,5%, en lugar del 0,6% estimado inicialmente.

item.title: EEUU impone sanciones contra red de financiación de Hamás, informa el Departamento del Tesoro
item.description: Estados Unidos impuso el viernes nuevas sanciones dirigidas contra la red financiera de Hamás, entre las que se incluyen medidas contra un miembro del ala militar del grupo militante palestino, dos recaudadores de fondos con sede en Francia y dos entidades, informó el Departamento del Tesoro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Estados Unidos impuso el viernes nuevas sanciones dirigidas contra la red financiera de Hamás, entre las que se incluyen medidas contra un miembro del ala militar del grupo militante palestino, dos recaudadores de fondos con sede en Francia y dos entidades, informó el Departamento del Tesoro. "Estas designaciones sacan a la luz una sofisticada estructura de financiación que lleva varios años en funcionamiento y que ha transferido más de 2 millones de dólares a Hamás a través de organizaciones benéficas ficticias y canales de criptomonedas, lo que demuestra la capacidad persistente de la organización para adaptar sus mecanismos de recaudación de fondos con el fin de eludir la detección", dijo el Tesoro en un comunicado. El miembro de Hamás Saleem Abdallah Saleem al-Zaq es un subcomandante de batallón en el ala militar de Hamás con sede en Gaza, dijo el Tesoro. Supervisa una red financiera que ha utilizado diversas empresas de servicios monetarios y carteras de criptomonedas para transferir fondos significativos a las Brigadas Al-Qassam de Hamás, añadió.

item.title: El Nasdaq toca máximo tras débil dato de empleo que reduce expectativas de alza de tasas en EEUU
item.description: Las acciones estadounidenses subían el viernes y el índice Nasdaq tocó un máximo histórico, porque las probabilidades de un alza de las tasas de interés en el corto plazo bajaban después de unos datos de empleo peores de lo esperado, lastrando a los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro, mientras que la baja de los precios del petróleo contribuía a aumentar el apetito por el riesgo.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: Las acciones estadounidenses subían el viernes y el índice Nasdaq tocó un máximo histórico, porque las probabilidades de un alza de las tasas de interés en el corto plazo bajaban después de unos datos de empleo peores de lo esperado, lastrando a los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro, mientras que la baja de los precios del petróleo contribuía a aumentar el apetito por el riesgo. Las acciones de semiconductores y de megacapitalización lideraban las alzas. Nvidia (NVDA.O) alcanzó un máximo histórico intradiario, con un alza del 2,5%, mientras que el índice de chips de Filadelfia (.SOX) ganaba un 3,1%. SpaceX (SPCX.O) , dirigida por Elon Musk, subía un 5,5%; Tesla (TSLA.O) sumaba un 4,1%, mientras que Oracle (ORCL.N) avanzaba un 3%. Las nóminas no agrícolas sumaron 29.000 puestos de trabajo el mes pasado y las cifras de los dos meses anteriores se revisaron drásticamente a la baja, mostró el viernes el muy esperado reporte de empleo del Departamento de Trabajo. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters habían pronosticado un aumento de 90.000. "La cifra de empleo más baja, incluida la revisión, es, por extraño que parezca, una buena noticia para las acciones. Dado que el mercado de bonos ha estado desempeñando de forma orgánica el papel de la Fed últimamente, necesitábamos sacrificar un indicador clave y el reporte de esta mañana ha cumplido ese objetivo", dijo Todd Schoenberger, director de inversiones de CrossCheck Management. Una serie de datos que muestran una actividad económica resistente y un aumento de los precios más lento de lo esperado, junto con los comentarios de al menos dos altos funcionarios de la Fed que se resisten a otra subida de tasas de interés, han llevado a los inversionistas a apostar cada vez más por que el banco central mantendrá las tasas sin cambios este mes. Los operadores ven ahora una probabilidad del 20% de que la Reserva Federal suba las tasas de interés 25 puntos básicos en octubre, frente al 26% anterior al reporte. El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a dos años , estrechamente vinculado a las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, retrocedía por segundo día consecutivo. A este sentimiento positivo se sumó que los precios del crudo Brent caían por debajo de los 100 dólares el barril tras conocerse que la Unión Europea había debatido nuevas liberaciones de reservas de diésel y crudo, a pesar de que no hubo novedades sobre la resolución del conflicto en Oriente Medio. A las 1503 GMT, el índice S&P 500 (.SPX) ganaba 66,95 puntos, o un 0,87%, a 7.733,40 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq (.IXIC) subía 378,80 puntos, o un 1,41%, a 27.250,39 unidades. En tanto, el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumaba 232,81 puntos, o un 0,46%, a 51.159,37 unidades. Diez de los once sectores principales del S&P 500 cotizaban al alza, con el sector de consumo discrecional (.SPLRCD) y el índice tecnológico (.SPLRCT) a la cabeza de las subidas, mientras que el índice sanitario (.SPXHC) era el único que se quedaba rezagado.

item.title: Vance's fraud crackdown may raise costs for US health insurers, enrollees
item.description: A crackdown on Obamacare health insurance could raise prices for US consumers and insurers by removing healthy, low-cost enrollees, adding pressure to a shrinking marketplace.
item.dc:creator: Amina Niasse
item.content:encoded: A crackdown on Obamacare health insurance could raise prices for US consumers and insurers by removing healthy, low-cost enrollees, adding pressure to a shrinking marketplace. The 2010 Affordable Care Act created income-based government-subsidized health plans for individuals, with 19 million people now enrolled. Millions have dropped out this year as extra COVID-19 pandemic subsidies expired. The Trump administration now says fraud contributed to the growth. Vice President JD Vance said last week the government had [USN:L4N45E0X6 TEXT:"removed 760,000 enrollees"] it believed did not exist or who had been fraudulently signed up by brokers and were unaware of their insurance coverage. Another 400,000 are under review. The government is also banning hundreds of brokers and will not accept new brokers, saying new brokers — who were paid a monthly fee for each enrollee — are often the ones who committed fraud. The changes could impact legitimate members who were simply not using their health plans because they were healthy, policy experts said. As the number of low-medical-use enrollees drops, a sicker mix of patients could eat into profits for insurers like UnitedHealth and Centene in the remaining months of 2026 and 2027, investors and analysts said. "The premium rates for 2027 have already been filed, and at this point, they've all been approved and locked down," said Matt McGough, a policy expert at health policy research firm KFF. UnitedHealth and Centene did not provide immediate comments. A spokesperson for the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services said the plan cancellations were based on a longstanding verification process, focused on enrollees who were signed up by a broker and were missing key identification information, like a US Social Security number. Legitimate enrollees can be reinstated after verifying their identity, the spokesperson said. The news has weighed on health insurance shares. Centene (CNC.N) , Molina (MOH.N) and Elevance (ELV.N) fell 1.5%, 6.5% and 4.2% in the week since the announcement while UnitedHealth (UNH.N) shares fell 2.6%. RISING COSTS Costs for patients and insurers were already on the rise in 2026 after the extra COVID-19 subsidies expired and medical costs rose. Insurers in July requested a median premium increase of 15% for 2027, according to a KFF analysis of rate filings across all 50 states and Washington, D.C., marking a second consecutive year of double-digit increases. 2027 plans are available starting on November 1. While insurers can adjust premiums when they anticipate healthcare cost increases, profits get squeezed by steep membership drop-offs after rates have been set. "Insurers generally do a great job pricing for a sicker population when they have reliable information, but unexpected changes in enrollment or policy after premiums are set create earnings risk," said Daniel Barasa, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds. Insurers will likely set prices even higher in 2028 to reflect the drop in enrollees, further exacerbating growth, three investors and two policy experts said. REPUTATIONAL HIT Brokers bring in 75% of people enrolled in the marketplace, according to government data released in 2026. Mike Smith, president emeritus at The Brokerage Inc., a brokerage agency in Flower Mound, Texas, said he thought consumers would be less likely to use brokers and sign up for plans because of the fraud announcement and ban on new brokers. "People will think negatively of the 'fraudulent insurance brokers' and paint all of the good brokers with a wide brush," Smith said. Obamacare plans can be purchased directly through Healthcare.gov or through state-run exchanges. There are 84,000 brokers nationwide who can help individuals pick a plan this year, according to the Department of Health and Human Services. Three investors said companies with a diverse business outside of Obamacare, such as UnitedHealthcare, will better navigate these changes. UnitedHealthcare is bolstering its employer-backed insurance plan choices as it moves away from ACA plans, Stephanie Link, chief investment strategist at Hightower Advisors, said. "Simply put, public exchanges have become less predictable," she said. "Lower volumes and higher pricing haven’t really worked."

item.title: Monedas suben tras dato de empleo en EEUU que reduce aún más expectativas alza tasas Fed
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina exhibían ganancias el viernes, en medio de un ligero retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales tras un nuevo dato del empleo en Estados Unidos que cementó las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal no subirá las tasas de interés en octubre.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina exhibían ganancias el viernes, en medio de un ligero retroceso del dólar en los mercados globales tras un nuevo dato del empleo en Estados Unidos que cementó las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal no subirá las tasas de interés en octubre. * [USN:L6N45O0QK TEXT:"El crecimiento del empleo"] en Estados Unidos se ralentizó más de lo esperado en septiembre, pero es probable que esto no suponga un cambio significativo en el mercado laboral, ya que esta debilidad podría deberse a una circunstancia puntual relacionada con el calendario. * El empleo no agrícola aumentó en 29.000 puestos de trabajo el mes pasado, tras un incremento revisado a la baja de 133.000 en agosto, reveló el viernes el informe de empleo del Departamento de Trabajo. * Tras la publicación de los datos del viernes, los contratos de futuros sobre tasas de interés reflejaban una probabilidad inferior a una entre cinco de que se produjera un aumento de tasas en la reunión de octubre de la Fed, frente a la probabilidad superior a una entre cuatro que se estimaba anteriormente. * Los operadores ya habían recortado el miércoles las expectativas de un alza de tasas, luego que un dato mostró que la inflación se aceleró menos de lo esperado en agosto, aunque los mercados siguen apostando a un incremento en diciembre, con una probabilidad cercana al 90%. * Tras el dato, el índice dólar , que compara a la divisa estadounidense frente a una canasta de seis importantes monedas, retrocedía alrededor de un 0,2%. * Además, en la sesión el petróleo caía con fuerza, reduciendo los temores inflacionarios, ante la liberación por parte de Europa y el grupo del G7 de reservas de diésel para intentar estabilizar los mercados energéticos mundiales, en medio del punto muerto en las negociaciones entre Estados Unidos e Irán para terminar con la guerra que inició a finales de febrero. * Y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos retrocedían tras el dato de empleo, relajando el fuerte avance de sesiones previas que llevó a los retornos a largo plazo a cotizar en máximos en décadas. * El peso mexicano cotizaba en 18,1275 por dólar, con una ganancia del 0,81% tras cuatro sesiones consecutivas de pérdidas, pero se encaminaba a registrar su peor desempeño semanal desde marzo. * En la semana, la moneda acumulaba una depreciación del 2,8%, como parte de en un rápido deterioro que ha sorprendido a inversionistas en las últimas semanas. A inicios de septiembre, el peso se negociaba por debajo de las 17 unidades por dólar, en niveles no vistos en más de dos años. * "La apreciación del peso... ocurre a la par de un retroceso del dólar... de acuerdo con el índice ponderado, luego de que en Estados Unidos el reporte de empleo de septiembre mostró señales de debilidad en el mercado laboral, permitiendo al mercado especular que la Reserva Federal podría ser más cautelosa para seguir subiendo la tasa de interés", dijo Banco Base en un reporte. * "Lo anterior también permitió correcciones a la baja en las tasas de interés de los instrumentos del Tesoro", agregó. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, subía un leve 0,06%, a 63.864,31 unidades y acumulaba una caída semanal del 1,7%, su peor desempeño desde agosto. * El real brasileño , sin embargo, se depreciaba un 0,10%, a 5,2208 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo retrocedía un 0,28%, a 186.632,56 puntos, con la cautela de los mercados previo a las elecciones presidenciales del domingo en la mayor economía de América Latina, aunque se espera que ningún candidato logre el triunfo en la primera vuelta. * El presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva aventaja al senador Flávio Bolsonaro, su principal rival, en una posible segunda vuelta de cara a las elecciones de este mes, reveló el jueves por la noche una encuesta de Datafolha. * Mientras, la producción industrial de Brasil cayó de forma inesperada en agosto, revelaron el viernes los datos de la agencia de estadística IBGE, lo que se suma a los indicios de que los elevados costos de financiación están lastrando la actividad económica. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista ganaba apenas un 0,1% a 1.523,5 por dólar, con regulación del banco central (BCRA) mediante la compra diaria de divisas para reforzar sus reservas internacionales. En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires sumaba un ligero 0,11%. * El peso chileno , avanzaba un 0,51%, a 980,50/980,80 unidades por dólar, tras cerrar en la víspera en mínimos desde abril del año pasado. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , caía un leve 0,05%, a 10.903,14 puntos. * El peso colombiano se apreciaba un 1,36% a 3.265 unidades por dólar; mientras que en la bolsa, el índice accionario colombiano MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) perdía un 0,41% a 2.520,12 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol subía un 0,41%, a 3.4360/3.4390 unidades por dólar. Por otra parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) ganaba un 0,49%, a 1.586,43 puntos.

item.title: Ex-Falcons C Jeff Van Note, 6-time Pro Bowler, dies at 80
item.description: Six-time Pro Bowl center Jeff Van Note, whose career with the Atlanta Falcons spanned parts of three decades, has died at age 80.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Six-time Pro Bowl center Jeff Van Note, whose career with the Atlanta Falcons spanned parts of three decades, has died at age 80. The Falcons announced the passing of their Ring of Honor member on Friday. "We mourn the loss of a true Falcons legend," team owner and chairman Arthur Blank said in a statement. "Jeff Van Note dedicated 18 seasons to this franchise and became one of the most respected and beloved players in our history. He embodied toughness, resilience, humility, and an unwavering commitment to his team, qualities that earned him the admiration of generations of Falcons fans." An 11th-round draft pick (262nd overall) in 1969, Van Note went on to play in 246 games with the Falcons from 1969-86. Only fellow offensive lineman and teammate Mike Kenn (251 games, 1978-94) made more appearances for Atlanta. Drafted as a linebacker out of Kentucky, Van Note moved to the offensive line under Atlanta head coach Norm Van Brocklin and became the full-time starting center in 1970. Van Note was a second-team All-Pro selection in 1979 and 1982 and made the Pro Bowl in 1974-75 and 1979-82. He was inducted into the Georgia Sports Hall of Fame in 1999 and the Falcons Ring of Honor in 2006. Following his playing career, Van Note served as a color commentator for Falcons and Kentucky football broadcasts through the 1990s. "Jeff's contributions to this organization cannot be measured solely by his accomplishments on the field," Blank said. "He helped shape the identity of the Atlanta Falcons and left a legacy that will endure for years to come. We are grateful for everything he meant to this franchise and our community. On behalf of the Falcons family, we extend our deepest sympathies to his children, Beau, Ben, and Blaine, and all who are grieving this tremendous loss. Jeff will always hold a special place in the history and heart of the Atlanta Falcons." --Field Level Media

item.title: Airbus board appointments herald CEO decision next year, sources say
item.description: Airbus has announced a series of board changes including its first female chairperson and the first from outside its Franco-German power base, marking the beginning of crucial leadership decisions expected in the coming year.
item.dc:creator: Tim Hepher
item.content:encoded: Airbus (AIR.PA) has announced a series of board changes including its first female chairperson and the first from outside its Franco-German power base, marking the beginning of crucial leadership decisions expected in the coming year. The European planemaker said late on Thursday that Spanish former energy executive Amparo Moraleda had taken over as chair of the board after being [USN:L6N40X12Q TEXT:"designated in"] April, succeeding Rene Obermann, who had already decided not to seek a new term. Obermann, whose mandate was to expire next April, had signalled his intention to stand down in April this year. A similar pattern was followed when Airbus tapped then-MTU Aero Engines (MTXGn.DE) CEO Lars Wagner to succeed Christian Scherer earlier than expected as divisional jetmaking CEO. He took over [USN:L1N3YR0PK TEXT:"in January"], more than a year after being publicly named, in part to meet handover rules at MTU. Several people familiar with the company said they expected a similar approach when deciding whether to renew or replace current CEO Guillaume Faury, with Wagner widely seen as heir apparent should Faury step down. That means a decision on whether to renew Faury as well as any possible handover if the board decides on change are expected in 2027, well ahead of the April 2028 deadline, by which time Faury will have been in the job for nine years. Two sources said Airbus could begin to look seriously at the CEO succession issue as early as April next year. An Airbus spokesperson declined to comment on "speculation over leadership appointments". CONTINUITY VS SUCCESSION The CEO at Airbus, with 160,000 staff and a product list ranging from jets that compete with Boeing (BA.N) to rockets and fighters, is one of Europe's most sensitive industrial roles. Airbus was born as a consortium backed by France, Germany, Britain and Spain in 1970, reshaped as one Franco-German-led group in 2000 and given autonomy over key appointments in 2013. The handling of the appointment is seen as a crucial test of Airbus' more market-focused recent governance. It takes place amid the first orderly backdrop to such a transition, following Franco-German power battles and French in-fighting up to 2019. Analysts say Airbus must now balance continuity with the case for locking in a successor to oversee strategic decisions including design choices for a future new plane next decade. Faury, 58, who was appointed in 2019 with an agenda to boost competitiveness and decarbonisation and oversaw Airbus through the COVID-19 crisis, has not ruled out serving a fourth term beyond 2028 and set out record profit targets for 2029 in July. Asked at the time if he would be the one delivering on those targets, Faury said: "I am fully available for the board to do what they think is appropriate for the company and enjoy what I'm doing". Wagner has not commented on his future but the former engine company boss set out a vision in January that includes reviewing crucial engine technologies for an A320 successor - a once-in-a-generation bet expected to dominate the next CEO's agenda. However, some sources said there are questions over how long Wagner, a soft-spoken but laser-focused 51-year-old, will agree to remain in the waiting room for the top Airbus job if he does not get picked, after already serving as a listed company CEO. Insiders said the group's management of human resources is also under scrutiny after months of on-off strikes in Spain, believed to be the longest dispute in the company's history. Staff [USN:L1N45N111 TEXT:"voted on Thursday to"] end the strike, which had snowballed as both the company and unions struggled to appeal to mainly young staff upset with efficiency measures and a return-to-work directive. Airbus dropped the four-day rule in August.

item.title: Dutch eyewear chain Hans Anders halts sale of Meta glasses, citing privacy concerns
item.description: One of the largest Dutch eyewear retail chains said on Friday it had suspended sales of Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses in the Netherlands and Belgium amid growing privacy concerns, in one of the first such moves by a retailer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: One of the largest Dutch eyewear retail chains said on Friday it had suspended sales of Meta's (META.O) Ray-Ban smart glasses in the Netherlands and Belgium amid growing privacy concerns, in one of the first such moves by a retailer. "This decision follows the ongoing public and political debate surrounding smart glasses and the questions being raised about the conditions under which this technology can be used," a spokesperson for the Hans Anders chain said. A growing Dutch outcry over the glasses mirrors a [USN:L4N45A01A TEXT:"broader backlash"] against smart glasses equipped with cameras. In Britain, pub chain Wetherspoon has restricted use of Meta's glasses over concerns about covert recording, while Meta and Luxottica face a US suit alleging videos captured by the glasses were viewed by human annotators without the knowledge of people filmed. A Meta spokesperson said the company is continuing to develop the popular glasses. "Every pair with a camera has a bright light on the front that blinks when you take a photo or video — it can't be turned off, and the camera is disabled if someone covers or tampers with it," they said. In the Netherlands, privacy regulator AP last month warned that videos made with smart glasses showing identifiable people cannot generally be shared or published without their permission, which would be difficult to obtain in a public place. Consumer rights group Consumentenbond this week said it would take Meta to court unless the company changes the glasses to comply with privacy law. Offlimits, a group that combats online abuse, on Friday also urged Meta and Ray-Ban owner EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) to voluntarily remove the glasses from sale until a way can be found to make surreptitious recordings impossible. EssilorLuxottica could not immediately be reached for comment. Hans Anders is a subsidiary of Nexeye, which is owned by private equity firm KKR (KKR.N) . Nexeye operates 776 stores across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria and Sweden. It does not sell the glasses in the latter three countries.

item.title: Mexico to prohibit presidents from holding dual citizenship
item.description: A Mexican constitutional reform to require presidential candidates to renounce any dual citizenships is fast-tracking toward final approval, despite criticism that the measure backed by the ruling party infringes on political rights and aims to block opposition rivals.
item.dc:creator: Lizbeth Diaz, Ana Martinez
item.content:encoded: A Mexican constitutional reform to require presidential candidates to renounce any dual citizenships is fast-tracking toward final approval, despite criticism that the measure backed by the ruling party infringes on political rights and aims to block opposition rivals. President Claudia Sheinbaum has defended the initiative — which would also apply to state governors and the Mexico City mayor — as a safeguard against foreign interference. "Presidents of Mexico can only have one flag, one homeland, one people to defend," Sheinbaum said during her daily news conference on Wednesday. Its critics, however, say it erects hurdles for dual-national politicians and could hamper generational succession within Sheinbaum's ruling Morena party and those of its allies, where several figures hold foreign passports. The constitutional changes were swiftly approved this week by a majority of Mexico's 32 state legislatures, backed by Morena lawmakers and their coalition after passing both chambers of the national Congress. Lawmakers must now issue a formal "declaration of constitutionality" before publishing the text in the official gazette. Mexico's current constitution does not explicitly bar presidents and governors from holding dual citizenship. In Latin America, only two countries have such bans: Cuba and Venezuela. The United States allows dual citizens to become president, but the issue has proven politically sensitive. Ted Cruz renounced his Canadian citizenship in 2014 ahead of his 2016 presidential run. PATRIOTISM OR POLITICAL SUBTERFUGE? Sheinbaum and her administration say that the citizenship proposal is part of the party's broader emphasis on defending national sovereignty amid mounting pressure from the administration of US President Donald Trump. But its critics have questioned both the speed of its passage and its political intentions ahead of the 2030 presidential election. The requirement would take effect for prospective candidates in 2028, meaning it would not affect current state governors or candidates competing in the 2027 midterms. Sheinbaum's office did not respond to requests for comment. Mexican billionaire Ricardo Salinas, a prominent tycoon and fierce critic of the administration who has repeatedly hinted at political ambitions, has railed against the bill and suggested that it was designed specifically to thwart his possible run. "Are they willing to screw over millions of Mexicans who migrated north... solely out of a sick desire to block a Mexican whom they fear and hate from the presidency?" Salinas wrote in a social media post in August. On Monday, Salinas appeared to reverse course, writing on social media that he did not hold dual citizenship. Reuters could not confirm whether Salinas holds a second citizenship. A spokesperson for Grupo Salinas declined to comment, describing his citizenship status as a private matter. A source within the Morena party, speaking on condition of anonymity, told Reuters the reform was aimed at hampering a possible run by Salinas. Larry Rubin, president of the American Society of Mexico, who holds dual US and Mexican citizenship, has also condemned the measure. "Having two nationalities does not make anyone less Mexican," Rubin said. "Do not turn your back on millions of dual nationals, migrants, and binational families." Mexican ambassador to the United States, Roberto Lazzeri, however, said the measure is not a referendum on dual citizenship, but rather a specific tightening of the requirements for the highest political offices. "Holding dual nationality does not make anyone less Mexican," he wrote on social media on Tuesday. But, he added, "the greater the public responsibility, the greater the obligations toward the country."

item.title: Fed deve pular alta de juros em outubro com arrefecimento do mercado de trabalho
item.description: Os membros do Federal Reserve ganharam nesta sexta-feira mais motivos para esperar antes de subir novamente as taxas de juros para combater a inflação, depois que dados mostraram que a criação de empregos está desacelerando e que a taxa de desemprego subiu ligeiramente.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir
item.content:encoded: Os membros do Federal Reserve ganharam nesta sexta-feira mais motivos para esperar antes de subir novamente as taxas de juros para combater a inflação, depois que dados mostraram que a criação de empregos está desacelerando e que a taxa de desemprego subiu ligeiramente. Essa foi a última análise abrangente do mercado de trabalho dos EUA antes das eleições de novembro, que determinarão se o Partido Republicano do presidente Donald Trump manterá o controle das duas casas do Congresso. O aumento do custo de vida, em meio à inflação elevada e aos custos mais altos dos empréstimos, deixou os eleitores insatisfeitos com a forma como os governantes atuais têm conduzido a economia, embora o crescimento econômico geral tenha sido sólido e o mercado de trabalho tenha se mantido bastante estável. Os dados mais recentes mostram que esse quadro pode estar mudando. Os empregadores dos EUA criaram apenas 29.000 empregos no mês passado, informou o Departamento do Trabalho nesta sexta-feira, menos do que os 90.000 esperados pelos economistas. Os dados de agosto sobre a criação de empregos foram revisados para baixo. A taxa de desemprego em setembro ficou em 4,2%, ante 4,1%. O crescimento dos salários desacelerou. O Fed elevou os juros em 25 pontos-base no mês passado para ajudar a trazer a inflação de volta à meta de 2%. Os formuladores de política monetária sinalizaram que provavelmente farão pelo menos mais um aumento até o final do ano se a guerra com o Irã e outros choques que impulsionaram a inflação persistirem, desde que o mercado de trabalho permaneça estável. Até o início desta semana, com um acordo de paz ainda distante e as tensões comerciais também em primeiro plano, as expectativas de uma série acelerada de aumentos nas taxas vinham crescendo, juntamente com os rendimentos dos títulos de longo prazo, que atingiram a maior alta em 24 anos na quinta-feira. As taxas de hipotecas ultrapassaram 7%. Mas, em declarações esta semana, duas autoridades particularmente influentes do Fed afirmaram que prefeririam analisar mais dados antes de considerar novas medidas, levando os operadores a reduzir drasticamente as apostas em um aumento na próxima reunião do Fed, de 27 a 28 de outubro, poucos dias antes das eleições. Após os dados de emprego divulgados na sexta-feira, os preços dos futuros de taxas de juros mostraram que os operadores veem apenas cerca de uma chance em seis de um aumento das taxas neste mês -- anteriormente, era mais de uma chance em quatro. As apostas em um aumento das taxas em dezembro também diminuíram, mas uma ação do Fed até lá ainda é vista como extremamente provável. A inflação, medida pelo indicador de referência do Fed, ficou em 3,4% em agosto, segundo dados divulgados nesta semana -- bem acima da meta de 2%, embora não tão ruim quanto os economistas haviam projetado. Economistas afirmaram que novos dados sobre as pressões de preços, a serem divulgados pouco antes da reunião dos formuladores de política monetária do Fed em Washington, ainda podem influenciar suas decisões. “Os relatórios do CPI (preços ao consumidor) e do PPI (preços ao produtor) de setembro, os preços na bomba de gasolina e os desdobramentos geopolíticos entre agora e a próxima reunião do Fed, no final de outubro, têm mais poder para influenciar a próxima decisão sobre as taxas do que este relatório de empregos”, escreveu Bill Adams, economista do Fifth Third.

item.title: Plaza financiera argentina abordada por selectividad y seguimiento externo
item.description: El mercado financiero argentino arrojaba este viernes una nueva ronda de marcada selectividad, mientras que el riesgo país se mantenía por arriba de los 600 puntos básicos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mercado financiero argentino arrojaba este viernes una nueva ronda de marcada selectividad, mientras que el riesgo país se mantenía por arriba de los 600 puntos básicos. Las miradas de los inversores posaban también en el impacto del dato de empleo en Estados Unidos y las implicancias políticas regionales con elecciones presidenciales del domingo en el vecino Brasil. En la bolsa de Buenos Aires, el referencial accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) arrojaba una ligera mejora del 0,11% a las 1445 GMT, al tiempo que los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles promediaban un marcha neutra. "El mercado en Estados Unidos reaccionó positivamente a datos peores que los esperados de tasa de desempleo y nóminas de empleados (...) La tasa de desempleo subió a 4,2%, frente al 4,1% esperado. Un mercado laboral más débil le quita fuerza a la expectativa de suba de tasas en la próxima reunión de la FED en octubre", remarcó Quantum Finanzas. Mientras tanto, el riesgo país argentino se movía en niveles de los 636 puntos básicos, muy lejos de las ansiadas 250 a 300 unidades como para que eventualmente el Gobierno pensara en retornar a los mercados internacionales de crédito ante un pesado panorama de vencimientos en el 2027. "Para la Argentina, el resultado electoral de Brasil no es neutro en el plano político: un nuevo mandato de Lula (da Silva)prolongaría la distancia con la Casa Rosada, mientras que un triunfo de (Flavio) Bolsonaro abriría una etapa de mayor afinidad con el Gobierno de (Javier) Milei", reportó la consultora ABECEB. "Sin embargo, el comercio bilateral se mantiene firme pese al enfriamiento diplomático, porque responde a una lógica productiva, con el intercambio automotriz como columna vertebral, que los vaivenes de la política no alcanzan a alterar", agregó. El peso mayorista ganaba apenas un 0,1% a 1.523,5 por dólar , con regulación del banco central (BCRA) mediante la compra diaria de divisas para reforzar sus reservas internacionales.

item.title: Halliburton no participará en proyecto petrolero en las Malvinas
item.description: Halliburton anunció el viernes que comunicó a las autoridades argentinas que no trabajará en el proyecto petrolero marítimo Sea Lion ni participará en actividades de exploración y producción de hidrocarburos en las islas Malvinas, ni en sus alrededores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Halliburton (HAL.N) anunció el viernes que comunicó a las autoridades argentinas que no trabajará en el proyecto petrolero marítimo Sea Lion ni participará en actividades de exploración y producción de hidrocarburos en las islas Malvinas, ni en sus alrededores. El proveedor de servicios petroleros añadió que las autoridades federales argentinas plantearon dudas sobre la posible participación de la empresa en el proyecto y sobre la aplicación de la legislación vigente y propuesta en relación con las actividades en el territorio británico en disputa. La declaración se conoce despues de que el presidente argentino, Javier Milei, intensificó la reivindicación del país sobre las islas Malvinas con sanciones para las empresas implicadas en la explotación petrolera del territorio británico de ultramar. En septiembre, Milei presentó un proyecto de ley para tomar medidas drásticas contra las empresas que operan en las Islas Malvinas, lo que podría agravar la tensión con el Reino Unido por el territorio controlado por Gran Bretaña pero reclamado por Argentina. Se estima que el yacimiento petrolero Sea Lion, situado a unas 225 kilometros al norte de las Islas Malvinas, alberga 1.700 millones de barriles de petróleo. Argentina se ha opuesto al proyecto desde su descubrimiento en 2010, cuando declaró ilegal la perforación en el yacimiento.

item.title: Ｇ７、石油備蓄1億バレルを協調放出へ 軽油を前倒し
item.description: [パリ ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２日 ロイター] - 主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）を通じて軽油などの備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。直ちに開始し、４カ月間にわたって実施する。

フランス大統領府が公表した声明によると、Ｇ７加盟国とパートナー国は最初の２０日間に大量の軽油を前倒しで放出する。マクロン仏大統領は、放出対象が軽油と原油で、規模は最大１億バレルになると説明した。

Ｇ７はまた、加盟各国の製油所の保守点検日程を調整する方針を表明。ＩＥＡに対し、２０２６年３月の約束が直ちに、かつ完全に履行されるよう監視することを要請した。

エネルギーおよびエネルギー製品について、Ｇ７諸国間で輸出制限を控えるとの約束を再確認。全ての生産国に対し、市場の緊張を悪化させかねない禁止措置を導入しないよう求めた。

マクロン氏は、ホルムズ海峡を通じた供給の確保に向け、引き続き行動を調整することで合意したと述べた。

声明はイランによる近隣諸国への攻撃を改めて非難し、ロシアに対する制裁を維持する方針も示した。

item.title: Chinese auto show debuts in Argentina as their sales surge
item.description: Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment.
item.dc:creator: Leila Miller
item.content:encoded: Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment. Chinese brands are flooding the market, benefiting from a measure that allows up to 50,000 electric and hybrid vehicles without tariffs in 2026. Chinese brands accounted for 10% of cars and light commercial vehicle sales in Argentina in August, up from about 2% late last year. Since launching in Argentina [USN:L6N3VO0YF TEXT:"in late 2025"], China's electric vehicle (EV) maker BYD (002594.SZ) , has become the ninth best-selling car brand. The company leads electric car sales in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Uruguay. At the auto show, there will be more than 20 Chinese brands, including [USN:L4N45E0BT TEXT:"Geely 0175.HK "], Chery (9973.HK) ,GWM (601633.SS) and [USN:L1N45K00B TEXT:"Dongfeng"]. Sebastian Beato, president of Argentina’s auto dealers’ association ACARA, said the "impressive" growth among Chinese brands had pushed the national industry to produce new models, such as the [USN:L8N4500PL TEXT:"Renault Niagara"] pick-up truck unveiled in September. Earlier this week the Argentine government said Japanese automaker Toyota Motor (7203.T) would [USN:L6N45M1A7 TEXT:"invest"] $1.34 billion to develop an EV plant in Argentina. If Argentina's auto industry doesn’t transform, "it’s going to have obsolete cars,” Beato said. MILEI UNCONCERNED Chinese automakers are steadily expanding across Latin America, selling both traditional vehicles and EVs at a pace that has alarmed some local markets. Brazil and Mexico have introduced tariffs aimed at slowing the influx and protecting domestic manufacturing jobs. But Milei, a libertarian, has said he is unconcerned by the rapid growth of Chinese automaker BYD and dismissed suggestions that it could complicate his close relationship with the United States, China's geopolitical rival, during an interview last month. "What Argentines buy is the problem of Argentines," Milei told Bloomberg at the Economic Club of New York. Tesla in July launched operations in Uruguay, and there are signs the US automaker could soon enter Argentina. The registration of Tesla Argentina appeared in the country's official gazette in April, and state energy company YPF said in June it had signed a letter of intent with Tesla to explore [USN:S0N41Q00Y TEXT:"energy storage"] opportunities. Tesla did not respond to a request for comment. 'POSSIBILITY TO COMPETE' Car sales in Argentina have fallen 13% so far this year from the same period in 2025, a decline that industry analysts attribute to a market adjustment after last year's strong growth was fueled by lower trade barriers. High interest rates have also dissuaded consumers from taking out car loans. Andres Civetta, an economist at consultancy Abeceb, said Argentina's auto industry should focus on pick-up trucks, where the country has established a strong export position and doesn't yet face competition from Chinese brands. Fernando Rodriguez Canedo, executive director of Argentina's association of car factories, welcomed Milei's gradual rollback of national export duties and said the industry was also pressing provincial governments to reduce local taxes. "That would give us the possibility to compete," Canedo said.

item.title: Trump deve anunciar Jay Clayton como czar da IA
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, deve nomear o diretor de Inteligência Nacional dos EUA, Jay Clayton, como seu principal assessor em IA — cargo que o presidente já chamou de “czar da IA” no passado —, segundo uma fonte a par da decisão.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra Alper, Courtney Rozen, Erin Banco
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, deve nomear o diretor de Inteligência Nacional dos EUA, Jay Clayton, como seu principal assessor em IA — cargo que o presidente já chamou de “czar da IA” no passado —, segundo uma fonte a par da decisão. Clayton já supervisiona 18 agências de inteligência dos EUA como principal chefe de espionagem do país. “Qualquer anúncio sobre pessoal será feito diretamente pelo presidente”, afirmou uma autoridade da Casa Branca em comunicado à Reuters quando questionada sobre a escolha de Clayton para o cargo. “Qualquer notícia divulgada até lá é especulação infundada.” A notícia foi divulgada pela primeira vez pela CBS. No mês passado, Trump disse que planeja nomear um assessor de inteligência artificial, conhecido como “czar da IA”, e criar uma “força de IA”, embora não tenha dado detalhes sobre nenhuma das iniciativas nem sobre como elas seriam implementadas. A iniciativa de Trump ocorre no momento em que importantes pesquisadores da área de IA alertam que os desenvolvedores acreditam que a inteligência artificial poderia matar seres humanos dentro de uma década, após casos de agentes de IA que se tornaram rebeldes e invadiram sistemas externos. Vários parlamentares democratas e republicanos reagiram com preocupação e pediram mais medidas. Esta é a segunda vez que Trump nomeia um assessor para supervisionar decisões relacionadas à IA. O investidor de risco David Sacks ocupou o cargo de responsável pela área de IA no início do segundo mandato de Trump, antes de deixar a Casa Branca. Sacks continua aconselhando Trump sobre IA e participou, na terça-feira, de uma reunião com o presidente e executivos do setor.

item.title: Pétrole Les pays du G7 vont libérer 100 millions de barils sous quatre mois-communiqué
item.description: Les dirigeants du G7 sont convenus vendredi de libérer leurs réserves stratégiques de produits pétroliers "jusqu'à 100 millions de barils, sous 4 mois" face à la crise énergétique mondiale, peut-on lire dans un communiqué.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les dirigeants du G7 sont convenus vendredi de libérer leurs réserves stratégiques de produits pétroliers "jusqu'à 100 millions de barils, sous 4 mois" face à la crise énergétique mondiale, peut-on lire dans un communiqué. La France assure actuellement la présidence du G7 et le chef de l'Etat français, Emmanuel Macron, a présidé vendredi une visioconférence sur la situation énergétique mondiale avec ses homologues, en coordination avec l'Agence internationale de l'énergie (AIE). "Nous sommes d'accord pour travailler de manière coordonnée pour contribuer à la baisse des prix des produits pétroliers, notamment du diesel", précise le communiqué du G7, relayé par la présidence française. Trois décisions ont ainsi été prises : - "flexibiliser la production pour produire au maximum de nos capacités de nos raffineries. - libérer nos réserves stratégiques jusqu'à 100 millions de barils, sous 4 mois, avec nos partenaires, sous la coordination de l'Agence internationale de l'énergie. - ne prendre aucune mesure de restriction des échanges de produits énergétiques et pétroliers entre pays partenaires."

item.title: How Turkey's investment fund bubble burst
item.description: Turkey's investment fund sector faces a deepening crisis after regulators last month ordered the liquidation of 131 funds managed by seven asset managers following warnings by some that they could not meet redemption payments.
item.dc:creator: Mirac Dereli, Canan Sevgili
item.content:encoded: Turkey's investment fund sector faces a deepening crisis after regulators last month ordered the liquidation of 131 funds managed by seven asset managers following warnings by some that they could not meet redemption payments. The funds had reached more than [USN:L6N45L0PJ TEXT:"$20 billion in assets"] over just three years, as nearly half a million investors including politicians, former officials and celebrities sought bumper returns to offset a depreciating lira and high inflation. This expansion continued even after Turkish authorities alleged that some funds were being used for market manipulation. The crisis dragged stocks into a bear market, with the main index having its [USN:L6N45M19Q TEXT:"worst month since"] 2008 in September. The following sets out the crisis and what may come next. HOW THE FUND BOOM BEGAN Turkey has kept monetary policy tight to tame inflation and encourage lira-denominated savings, boosting interest in funds offering returns above inflation and local deposit rates. Some of the investment funds became concentrated in a single stock or asset, while others had only a handful of investors. Some of these funds traded recently listed small-cap shares, where lower liquidity allowed prices to move sharply, which in turn boosted the daily returns of the funds holding them. WARNING SIGNS Turkish officials [USN:L8N3WG0M3 TEXT:"warned about manipulation"] through investment funds in November 2025. "We know that these manipulations are being carried out particularly through certain funds," Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek said, adding that regulatory gaps would be addressed. Omer Gonul, then the chairman of Turkey's Capital Markets Board (SPK), said regulators were monitoring funds used to circumvent rules and warned that managers could face penalties including license cancellations. TWO FUNDS AT CENTRE OF CRISIS Two asset managers at the centre of the turmoil, Tera Portfoy and Pusula Portfoy, expanded rapidly before the crisis. Tera and Pusula have not responded to Reuters requests for comment. Turkey's portfolio management industry assets rose to $329 billion in August 2026 from $246 billion a year earlier, data from the Capital Markets Board shows. Tera's assets under management increased more than 10-fold to $14.3 billion over the same period, while Pusula's assets jumped 13-fold to $13.2 billion as more investors trickled in. By the end of August, Tera was sixth and Pusula eighth among Turkey's portfolio managers, each with a share of total managed assets exceeding 4%, making them the sector's biggest non-bank companies. CUMULATIVE RETURN OF 15,000% Some funds reported sharp rises in assets and investors. Tera's TLY hedge fund returned 747% in lira terms between January and July 2025, when it had fewer than 200 investors. After becoming available to a broader investor base in July, its cumulative return climbed to more than 15,000% in lira terms by September. TLY attracted 102,616 investors and grew to $5 billion in assets, making it the largest of the funds being liquidated. It was followed by Tera's TP2 money market fund, with $4.6 billion in assets and around 167,000 investors. TP2 provided a 123% return to investors over the same period, when the inflation rate was 60%. WHO HAS BEEN CAUGHT UP IN THE CRISIS? Regulators have widened their investigation into suspected market manipulation in stocks and fund markets. Justice Minister Akin Gurlek [USN:L8N45M11P TEXT:"said"] that the number of suspects had risen to 217, with 56 jailed pending trial. Fatma Betul Sayan Kaya, a deputy chair of President Tayyip Erdogan's ruling AKP, [USN:L8N45J00R TEXT:"resigned"] from her party posts after an opposition politician alleged that she and her husband had made substantial profits trading Ozata Denizcilik (OZATD.IS) shares ahead of the turmoil. The shares are part of a broader market manipulation investigation. Kaya said on X she considered it necessary to take political responsibility while the allegations were examined. She did not comment further. Those jailed include senior executives [USN:L6N45B05S TEXT:"linked to"] Tera and Pusula. Erkan Kilimci, a former central bank deputy governor who later became a Tera executive, was also jailed, broadcaster NTV said. Kilimci said in a LinkedIn post before he was jailed that it was "unlucky" to have his name caught up in the allegations due to the senior Tera post he occupied for three months. Kilimci's post did not directly comment on the allegations and Reuters was unable to reach his representatives for further comment. Kaya's adviser did not respond to a request for comment. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? Istanbul's main index (.XU100) closed 2.5% higher on Thursday as [USN:L1N45E07V TEXT:"sweeping changes"] to its constituents took effect, removing stocks caught up in the crisis. The SPK said liquidating the funds will take six months and investors in certain funds with net investments below 1 million lira ($20,396) will get full repayment. Those with 1 million lira [USN:L6N45N0DI TEXT:"or more invested"] will receive an interim payment of 1 million lira. Turkey's Savings Deposit Insurance Fund has opened accounts for investors seeking to return what authorities describe as "excessive gains" from fund sales. JPMorgan [USN:L8N45O0G7 TEXT:"analysts said"] the fund sector turmoil brought "meaningful downside risks" to Turkey's 2026 GDP growth forecast of 3%. It remains unclear how much the total loss to investors will be. Attention is turning to the prices at which fund assets can be converted into cash as many funds hold thinly traded stocks, potentially complicating the process.

item.title: Blazers hire, fire announcer on same day after old posts surface
item.description: Just hours after the Portland Trail Blazers announced the hiring of play-by-play announcer Braiden Bell, they fired him.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Just hours after the Portland Trail Blazers announced the hiring of play-by-play announcer Braiden Bell, they fired him. On Thursday, he was named to replace longtime announcer Kevin Calabro but then dismissed after social media posts he made as a teenager were uncovered. The posts, on Twitter (now X), called women derogatory names and included an insult to Asians, although Bell referred to himself as "not racist" in the same post. The comments were posted in late 2012 and early 2013. "The Portland Trail Blazers have zero tolerance for racist, sexist, or harmful comments," the team said in a statement posted to social media later Thursday. "Social media posts made by our recently announced play-by-play broadcaster are in clear violation of team and league policies, as well as our values and expectations. Therefore, we will not be moving forward with this broadcaster." The Trail Blazers learned about the posts from a reporter for KGW in Portland who uncovered them and asked the club for comment. According to Bell's LinkedIn page, he studied journalism at Arizona State from 2015-19 and then became the voice of Cal Baptist sports in fall 2019. He left that post in mid-2024 and began calling games for Arizona State, the WNBA's Phoenix Mercury and the Valley Suns of the G League. Last fall, he also made his debut with FS1 on Big 12 football. Bell has not commented publicly since his dismissal, but earlier in the day, expressed his appreciation for the new job. "Rip City -- Wow, it's going to be an awesome ride!" he posted. "It's hard to describe the honor I'm feeling. I can't wait to settle into this community & fanbase. "My goal is to make you proud every game and honor the incredible history & tradition of Blazers play-by-play. Talk to you soon!" He since has made his X account private. The franchise's statement included an apology. "We did not meet our own bar in this process, and for that we apologize to Blazers fans and to Rip City," the Trail Blazers said. "We strongly believe that everyone who is a part of Rip City should feel welcome and safe and we will make sure that our new broadcaster reflects these values. We will do better." The team begins the new season Oct. 21 at home against the Phoenix Suns. --Field Level Media

item.title: Meta’s Muse is adorable agent of value destruction
item.description: The digital concierge may have a cute mascot, but its chart-topping release devoured $1 trln of market value once held by travel, financial and media firms. At least the panic might be brief: new agent rivals and sophisticated use of AI by affected businesses will be equalizers.
item.dc:creator: Robert Cyran
item.content:encoded: Cute raccoons decimated Japan's natural habitat after pets were let loose in the wild. The same dynamic is playing out with Muse, the AI agent released by Meta Platforms (META.O) in early September. The digital concierge's adorable, chubby mascot helped propel it to 5 million downloads, only to wreak havoc in markets. Services, financial, media, and other industries' valuations were punished on fears that an automated assistant would trash their business models. The panic might be short-lived. Over the past month, the headline S&P 500 Index (.SPX) , which represents over three quarters of US stock-market capitalization, was roughly unchanged. Constituent Meta, however, gained some $450 billion in value. Combined with gains for big chip firms Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Intel (INTC.O) and AMD (AMD.O) , the sum is over $1 trillion. Nearly everything else fell, implying other sectors shed a similar amount. Sure, higher interest rates and energy prices are also a cause. But investors fear Meta’s agent may decimate ecosystems dependent on subscriptions, middlemen, and consumer laziness. Travel companies seem obvious losers. Just as the internet replaced agencies with easy and cheaper self-service, Muse may displace them with cheap automation. Shares of Booking (BKNG.O) and Expedia (EXPE.O) lost close to a fifth of their value in a month. Worry over agents canceling user subscriptions hurt others. Close to a fifth of recurring payments are for unused services, according to a CNET survey. The pain rippled through companies like Netflix (NFLX.O) , Spotify Technology (SPOT.N) and Planet Fitness (PLNT.N) which lost 18%, 12% and 20%, respectively. Business services and intermediaries were also whacked. Tax forms can be farmed out to a bot instead of an accountant, sending H&R Block (HRB.N) and Intuit (INTU.O) down nearly 20%. Car vendors like AutoNation (AN.N) and CarMax (KMX.N) saw a similar fall on fears brainy digital assistants might gather relevant comparisons and bargain relentlessly for better deals. Finally, financial institutions also lost on the prospect of well-off customers handing the keys to AI helpers. Credit card debt might automatically transfer to zero-rate offers, and low-interest deposits could be sent to higher-yielding pastures. Capital One (COF.N) and Bank of America (BAC.N) lost more than 10%. The list of winners was smaller, with Meta heading it. Yet leading machine-learning products tend to quickly face improved or cheaper offerings from rivals. Renewed fears over hefty investment could easily vaporize the tech giant’s gains. Customers may benefit as automated assistants take over bill paying and discount negotiation. But businesses will use AI themselves, attempting to wring higher margins and wrong-foot consumers' bots. If the future is both sides relying on agents to extract value from each other, perhaps the only real beneficiaries will be chipmakers powering the arms race. Follow Robert Cyran on Bluesky . Muse, Meta Platforms’ new AI agent, exceeded 5 million downloads on September 30 according to market research firm Sensor Tower. Meta released Muse on September 8. In addition to a free, basic level of service, people can pay $20 or $100 per month for progressively heavier use. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: 米韓、84億ドルの石油事業巡り食い違い トランプ氏「通商合意の一環」
item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、韓国との通商合意に８４億ドル規模の石油増進回収（ＥＯＲ）プロジェクトが含まれると明らかにした。ただ、
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、韓国との通商合意に８４億ドル規模の石油増進回収（ＥＯＲ）プロジェクトが含まれると明らかにした。ただ、 韓国の聨合ニュースは産業通商資源省高官の話として、同プロジェクトは両国間の戦略的投資協定の一環ではないと報じた。

トランプ大統領は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「韓国との合意は一段と改善している！石油増進回収プロジェクトに８４億ドルが投じられる。石油・ガスの増産は、米国のエネルギー覇権と将来に向けた世界のエネルギー安全保障につながる！」と投稿した。

聨合ニュースの報道によると、韓国政府の当局者は米国側に問い合わせを行ったという。

トランプ氏は９月３０日、韓国が米国内の事業に約２０００億ドルを投資すると発表。ただ、韓国政府はその後、計画の柱の一つとされたアラスカ州の液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）事業向け５４０億ドル規模のパイプライン建設について、現時点で確定したものではないとの認識を示していた。

item.title: Nasdaq atinge máxima recorde após dados de emprego nos EUA reduzirem apostas em alta de juros
item.description: As ações dos Estados Unidos subiam nesta sexta-feira, levando o Nasdaq a uma máxima recorde, depois que dados de emprego abaixo do esperado reduziram as chances de um aumento da taxa de juros no curto prazo, levando os rendimentos dos Treasuries a uma queda, enquanto os preços mais baixos do petróleo contribuíam para o apetite por risco.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: As ações dos Estados Unidos subiam nesta sexta-feira, levando o Nasdaq a uma máxima recorde, depois que dados de emprego abaixo do esperado reduziram as chances de um aumento da taxa de juros no curto prazo, levando os rendimentos dos Treasuries a uma queda, enquanto os preços mais baixos do petróleo contribuíam para o apetite por risco. As ações do setor de chips e as megacaps lideravam os ganhos. A Nvidia (NVDA.O) atingiu um pico recorde intradiário com alta de 2,5%, enquanto o índice de chips da Filadélfia (.SOX) registrava alta de 3,1%. Entre outras empresas de grande porte, a SpaceX (SPCX.O) subi 5,5%, a Tesla (TSLA.O) ganhava 4,1% e a Oracle (ORCL.N) tinha alta de 3%. A economia dos EUA abriu 29.000 vagas de trabalho fora do setor agrícola no mês passado, e os números dos dois meses anteriores foram revisados acentuadamente para baixo, mostrou nesta sexta-feira o relatório de emprego do Departamento do Trabalho. Economistas consultados pela Reuters previam criação de 90.000 postos de trabalho. “O número mais baixo de empregos, incluindo a revisão, é, por mais estranho que pareça, uma boa notícia para as ações. Com o mercado de títulos desempenhando organicamente o papel do Federal Reserve recentemente, precisávamos sacrificar um indicador, e o relatório desta manhã atingiu esse objetivo”, disse Todd Schoenberger, diretor de investimentos da CrossCheck Management. Uma série de dados que mostram resiliência na atividade econômica e um aumento dos preços mais lento do que o esperado, juntamente com comentários de pelo menos duas autoridades se opondo a outro aumento nos juros, levaram os investidores a apostar cada vez mais que o banco central deixará os juros inalterados neste mês. Os operadores agora atribuem uma probabilidade de 20% de que o Federal Reserve aumente os juros em 25 pontos-base em outubro, em comparação com 26% antes do relatório. O rendimento do Treasury de dois anos , que está intimamente ligado às expectativas de taxas de juros, recuava pelo segundo dia consecutivo. Contribuindo para o otimismo, os preços do petróleo Brent caíram para menos de US$100 o barril após notícia de que a União Europeia discutiu novas liberações de estoques de diesel e petróleo bruto, embora não houvesse novas atualizações sobre a resolução do conflito no Oriente Médio. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subia 0,60%, para 51.233,34 pontos, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) ganhava 1,02%, a 7.744,76 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha alta de 1,66%, para 27.319,43 pontos. (Reportagem adicional de Shashwat Chauhan)

item.title: Torres withdrawn from Spain squad due to injury, Espi called up
item.description: Spain forward Ferran Torres has withdrawn from the national squad with an ankle issue and will be replaced by Carlos Espi for the upcoming Nations League matches, the Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Spain forward Ferran Torres has withdrawn from the national squad with an ankle issue and will be replaced by Carlos Espi for the upcoming Nations League matches, the Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) said on Friday. Torres, who plays for Paris St Germain, has been troubled by minor discomfort in his left ankle and, despite training in recent days, was released from the squad to prioritise his recovery, the RFEF said. Coach Luis de la Fuente called up Espi in his place, rewarding the Real Madrid youngster after he scored five goals and set up two more in Spain Under-21s' 13-0 rout of San Marino on Thursday. "Due to the persistence of the symptoms, the decision was made to withdraw him from the squad to prioritise his recovery," the federation said in a statement, adding its medical staff had remained in constant contact with PSG throughout the camp. Spain host the Czech Republic in Oviedo on Saturday before travelling to face Croatia on October 6.

item.title: 米製造業新規受注、8月は0.1％の小幅増 民間航空機が重し
item.description: [ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した８月の製造業新規受注は前月比０．１％増の小幅な伸びにとどまっ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米製造業新規受注、8月は0.1％の小幅増　民間航空機が重し 10/2 23:45 配信

米ワシントン州エベレットにある航空機大手ボーイングの工場。７月撮影。Jennifer Buchanan/Seattle Times

[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した８月の製造業新規受注は前月比０．１％増の小幅な伸びにとどまった。電気機器・家電製品・同部品への強い需要があったものの、低調な民間航空機の受注に相殺された。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．１％増だった。

７月は０．９％増から０．８％増に下方改定された。

８月は前年同月比では６．８％増加した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラの拡充に加え、堅調な国内需要に対応するため企業が在庫を再構築していることが製造業の下支えとなっている。ただ、米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争がサプライチェーン（供給網）を混乱させ、エネルギー価格を押し上げている中で、ＡＩ投資ブームと関連性の薄い分野は今後数カ月間、苦戦を強いられる可能性があるとの懸念もある。

８月は、民間航空機・同部品の受注が４．３％減少したことが重しとなった。自動車車体・同部品・トレーラーの受注は０．８％増。機械受注は１．１％増加した。コンピューター・電子製品の受注は横ばいだった一方、前年同月比では１４．７％増加した。電気機器・家電製品・同部品の受注は１．１％急増した。

企業の設備投資計画の指標とされる航空機を除く非国防資本財（コア資本財）の受注は１．６％増と、先月発表の速報値から変わらずだった。コア資本財の出荷は０．５％増と、当初発表の０．６％増から下方改定された。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米株高支える高い増益、投資家は持続可能性に不安も 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：出遅れ気味の米不動産株、持ち直し期待高まる 焦点：後退する米企業役員の多様性、トランプ米大統領の政策反映 コラム：「米国例外主義」なお健在、外国投資家のテック株流入持続が示唆 最終更新: 10/2(金) 23:45 ロイター

item.title: El G7 liberará 100 millones de barriles de diésel y otras reservas a través de la AIE
item.description: El grupo de países del G7 llevará a cabo una liberación coordinada de 100 millones de barriles de diésel y otras reservas a través de la Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE) para intentar estabilizar los mercados energéticos mundiales, según una declaración conjunta de los líderes del G7 emitida el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El grupo de países del G7 llevará a cabo una liberación coordinada de 100 millones de barriles de diésel y otras reservas a través de la Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE) para intentar estabilizar los mercados energéticos mundiales, según una declaración conjunta de los líderes del G7 emitida el viernes. "Cumpliremos nuestros compromisos con una liberación coordinada, a través de la AIE, de 100 millones de barriles que comenzará de inmediato y se prolongará durante cuatro meses, incluida una liberación sustancial de diésel concentrada en los primeros 20 días por parte de los miembros y socios del G7", dice la declaración, difundida por la oficina del presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron.

item.title: Five French market hot spots on investors' radars
item.description: French markets are under growing pressure from mounting worries about high debt levels and political gridlock as next year's presidential election nears.
item.dc:creator: Amanda Cooper, Harry Robertson, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: French markets are under growing pressure from mounting worries about high debt levels and political gridlock as next year's presidential election nears. The French government is seeking €54 billion ($61 billion) in savings in its 2027 budget proposal amid[USN:L1N45O03R TEXT:" protests at schools across the country"] over a lack of resources. Here's a look at five key metrics that have started to flash a warning, potentially further hampering the government's ability to rein in its [USN:L8N4591JN TEXT:"strained finances"]. RISK PREMIUM HITS CRISIS LEVELS The gap between French 10-year borrowing costs and their German equivalents, a measure of the risk premium attached to French debt, has [USN:L6N45C068 TEXT:"risen to its highest"] since the euro zone crisis in 2012, at around 150 basis points . The speed of the move has surprised markets. The French risk premium hasn't blown out this quickly in the space of a week since 2011, when the debt crisis was raging. Ultimately, the European Central Bank has tools to prevent any euro zone member's bond yields from spiralling out of control, although analysts believe [USN:L1N45N0CH TEXT:"there is little chance"] the central bank would need to resort to those for France yet. "Clearly, the market is testing the political situation, telling the politicians: 'you need to be careful with the budget,'" Marion Le Morhedec, CIO of fixed income at Fidelity, told an event on Friday. STOCKS AND BANKS LAG France’s stock market (.FCHI) , down nearly 4% this year, has lagged broader European markets (.STOXX) , which are up roughly 6%. Economic growth is slowing. The Bank of France expects [USN:L1N4570F4 TEXT:"an expansion of just 0.4% this year"], down from 0.9% in 2025. Domestic banks have struggled [USN:L8N4530IU TEXT:"in this low-growth environment"] given concerns about political uncertainty and high government debt. Credit Agricole shares (CAGR.PA) are down 3.8% this year and Societe Generale is down nearly 4% (SOGN.PA) . BNP Paribas (BNPP.PA) shares are up 13.3% in 2026, but are well below the highs of the year. The broader European STOXX banking index (.SX7P) is up 14% in 2026. AT1 bonds, a form of riskier debt issued by French lenders, have come under pressure along with the rest of the market, but less so than France's government debt, suggesting investors are not too concerned yet about the pressure on the banking sector. AT1 bonds act as shock absorbers if a bank's capital levels fall below a certain threshold. They can be converted into equity or written off. CREDIT RISKS MOUNT The cost of insuring French sovereign debt against an increase in default risk has continued to soar, LSEG data shows. With bond yields rising everywhere, credit default swaps have risen for most sovereigns, but the speed at which they have increased for France is far greater than anywhere else. French 5-year CDS trade around 87 basis points, the most since early 2013. That means it costs 87 cents annually to insure every $100 held in French bonds. That's still below the record highs near 200 bps in 2012, but nearly triple what it was just one month ago. In the last three months alone, French CDS have risen 60 bps, compared with 50 bps for Italy and little change for German, US or UK CDS. EURO GLOOM DEEPENS The weaker euro could compound the government's fiscal problems by making imported goods and energy more expensive. The euro has fallen below $1.13 to its weakest level in nearly 18 months, while euro zone bond yields have risen. A falling currency and rising yields typically reflect heightened investor unease. The rise in bond yields has effectively tightened credit conditions enough to prompt traders to assume the ECB will deliver at least two hikes in the coming year, with a roughly 50/50 chance of a third, down from an expectation for at least three hikes last week. Some ECB policymakers have also [USN:L8N4591NP TEXT:"sought to"] [USN:L1N45A0DM TEXT:"temper aggressive market expectations"] for rate hikes. "With growth facing renewed headwinds and French sovereign stress tightening financial conditions independently, we remain sceptical that the ECB can sustain the deposit rate materially above 3%," strategists at Monex said. The ECB deposit rate is currently at 2.5%. CONTAGION RISK One of the principal worries with any major market move is contagion — where investors are forced to sell other assets to cover losses elsewhere — that adds to the down-draught. Italian debt has been performing better than French debt for several years now, as the government in Rome made strides to bring the country's finances into order. But given Italy's large deficit, its bonds and CDS have been pummelled too.
